Textual functions (topic shifting, signaling relationships, boundary marking, attention guidance, topic introduction, and topic emphasis) were most frequent, followed by interactive functions (turn management, listener engagement, and feedback regulation), and modal functions (epistemic stance, emotional expression, and attitudinal marking). Prosodic analysis revealed that duration and intensity are key cues for distinguishing hālā's functions. Textual uses were significantly shorter, while temporal uses showed a tendency toward longer realizations. Interactive functions correlated with higher intensity, while modal functions showed a weaker tendency toward lower intensity. These findings indicate that duration and intensity are the main prosodic cues associated with functional differentiation in hālā, especially in textual and interactive uses.

</details>


### [160] [Beyond a Single Judge: Simulating Social Persona Panels for Generative UI Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28439)
*Zheng Wu,Yibo Luo,Pu Zhang,Cheng Yang,Zhuosheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 ESPP（证据支撑、社会加权的人格面板），一种三阶段 GenUI 评估方法：心理多样化人格独立评分 → 特质驱动的有界置信意见交换 → Delphi 启发式社会加权聚合。相比单一 LLM 评判，Pearson r 从 0.716 提升至 0.922，且揭示用户子群在评分维度上的结构性分歧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GenUI 评估面临困境：人工评估昂贵且评分者间存在差异，LLM-as-a-judge 虽可扩展但仅反映单一隐式视角，无法捕捉不同真实用户群体对同一界面的感知差异。

Method: ESPP 三阶段流程：(1) 构建心理学多样化、证据支撑的人格面板，各人格独立对界面截图评分；(2) 人格间基于特质衍生的语义门控有界置信机制交换意见；(3) 采用 Delphi 启发的社会加权方法将多元评分聚合为单一判断。

Result: ESPP 与人类判断的相关性显著优于朴素单轮 LLM 评判：Pearson r 从 0.716 提升至 0.922。提示集成对照仅弥合约三分之一差距，证实人格多样性与证据支撑是增益主因。此外，用户子群在模型整体排名上一致，但在具体评分维度上存在显著分歧，单一评判会系统性抹除此类结构性分歧。

Conclusion: ESPP 通过心理多样化人格面板与结构化意见聚合，显著提升了 GenUI 自动评估与人类判断的一致性，同时保留了子群层面的评分分歧信息，为 UI 生成评估提供了更忠实、更细粒度的自动化方案。

Abstract: Generative UI (GenUI) lets large language models synthesize a complete, renderable interface directly from a natural-language instruction, but evaluating the quality of what they generate remains an open problem. Human evaluation is costly and rater-variant, while LLM-as-a-judge is scalable but reflects only a single implicit viewpoint, unable to capture how different populations of real users actually perceive the same interface. We propose the Evidence-Grounded, Social-Weighted Persona Panel (ESPP), a three-stage GenUI evaluation method in which a panel of psychologically diverse, evidence-grounded personas independently rates a screenshot, exchanges opinions under a trait-derived, semantically-gated bounded-confidence mechanism, and is aggregated via Delphi-inspired social weighting into a single judgment. ESPP tracks human judgment substantially more closely than a naive single-pass judge, raising Pearson $r$ from $0.716$ to $0.922$, and a prompt-ensemble control recovers only about a third of this gap, isolating genuine persona and evidence grounding as the dominant source of improvement. Beyond this fidelity gain, retaining each panelist's individual rating further reveals that user subgroups agree on overall model rankings yet diverge sharply on specific rating dimensions, a structural disagreement a single homogeneous judge would systematically erase. The codes are available at https://github.com/Wuzheng02/ESPP.

</details>


### [161] [Lightning OPD 2.0: Mitigating Style Bias in Cross-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Large Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28449)
*Yecheng Wu,Song Han,Han Cai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Lightning OPD 2.0 通过交叉拟合风格残差化技术，消除了跨教师场景下因文体差异带来的偏差，使得在线策略蒸馏不再要求SFT数据生成器与蒸馏教师必须为同一模型，显著提升了数学推理和代码生成任务的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）要求教师模型与生成SFT数据的模型一致（即教师一致性条件），但实践中SFT数据来源混杂或不同模型各有所长时，该条件常被违反。在跨教师设置下，即使更强的OPD教师也难以带来提升。作者发现原始教师-参考模型间的分歧包含有用的上下文特定证据和与措辞、格式、推理节奏相关的重复性文体偏差，后者需要被剔除。

Method: 提出 Lightning OPD 2.0，核心是交叉拟合风格残差化（cross-fitted style residualization）。该方法使用rollout-level的交叉拟合来估计教师与参考模型间由风格token引起的重复性偏差分量，将其作为风格偏差的操作性代理变量，在构建token级OPD更新前将其减去，从而净化蒸馏信号。

Result: 在数学推理和代码生成基准测试中，Lightning OPD 2.0 在跨教师设置下一致优于原始 Lightning OPD。以 Klear-Reasoner-8B-SFT 为起点，在 AIME 2024 上达到 82.4%，在 LiveCodeBench v5 上达到 63.0%。

Conclusion: Lightning OPD 2.0 是一种实用的跨教师在线策略蒸馏方法，放松了教师一致性这一前提条件，使得SFT数据生成器和蒸馏教师可以独立选择，为在线策略蒸馏的灵活部署铺平了道路。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision from a teacher, but its effectiveness can depend on teacher consistency, meaning that the model providing OPD supervision should also have generated the demonstrations used to train the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) reference. However, this condition is frequently violated in practice when SFT data have mixed or unknown provenance or when different models are preferred for SFT data generation and subsequent distillation. In such cross-teacher settings, even a stronger OPD teacher can yield little improvement over the SFT reference. We find that raw teacher--reference disagreement contains potentially useful context-specific teacher evidence as well as a recurring component associated with differences in wording, formatting, and reasoning cadence. We introduce Lightning OPD 2.0 with cross-fitted style residualization, which uses rollout-level cross-fitting to estimate this recurring component as an operational proxy for style-token bias and subtracts it before constructing the token-level OPD update. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, Lightning OPD 2.0 consistently outperforms Lightning OPD in cross-teacher settings. Starting from Klear-Reasoner-8B-SFT, Lightning OPD 2.0 reaches 82.4% on AIME 2024 and 63.0% on LiveCodeBench v5. Together, these results establish Lightning OPD 2.0 as a practical approach to cross-teacher OPD, relaxing teacher consistency as a prerequisite and allowing the SFT data generator and distillation teacher to be selected independently. Code will be released soon.

</details>


### [162] [Improving Mental Health Screening and Early Risk Detection in Spanish](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28476)
*Andreu Casamayor-Segarra,Vicent Ahuir,Antonio Molina-Marco,Lluís-F. Hurtado*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对西班牙语心理健康早期检测的挑战，提出三项贡献：领域预训练的西班牙语基础模型、用于早期检测的增量上下文扩展（ICE）自动重标注方法、以及基于ICE微调的早期风险检测模型，在三个西班牙语基准上实现了延迟降低且性能提升的SOTA结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 西班牙语心理健康早期检测面临两大瓶颈：一是西班牙语专用资源匮乏，二是社交媒体长文本历史难以有效分析，导致难以在早期阶段准确识别心理障碍。

Method: （1）通过领域特定预训练，构建三个面向心理健康领域的西班牙语基础模型；（2）提出ICE（Incremental Context Expansion）自动重标注方法，识别累计消息中何时能提供足够证据判定障碍，从而生成更具信息量的训练样本；（3）利用ICE生成的样本对模型进行微调，用于早期风险检测任务。

Result: 在三个西班牙语基准数据集上，将专用模型与ICE方法相结合，超越了现有最优水平，在保持高检测性能的同时有效降低了检测延迟。

Conclusion: 领域自适应预训练结合ICE重标注策略，能够显著提升西班牙语心理健康早期检测的效果，所有模型已公开发布以促进进一步研究。

Abstract: Early detection of mental health disorders is often limited by the lack of specialized resources in Spanish and the difficulty of analyzing long histories of social media posts. This paper addresses these challenges through three main contributions. First, we introduce three Spanish foundational models specifically adapted to the mental health domain through domain-specific pre-training. Second, we propose Incremental Context Expansion (ICE), an automatic relabeling methodology designed for early detection. ICE identifies the point at which cumulative messages provide enough evidence of a disorder, generating more informative training samples. Third, we provide a set of fine-tuned models using the samples generated with the ICE methodology for early risk detection tasks. Our results on three Spanish benchmarks show that combining these specialized models with ICE improves the state-of-the-art, reducing detection latency while maintaining high performance. All models are publicly available.

</details>


### [163] [Would You Walk to the Car Wash? Revealing the Salience Bias of Large Language Models in Commonsense Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28478)
*Zheng Wu,Chenhao Xue,Shijie Zheng,Yijie Lu,Cheng Yang,Zhuosheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文揭示了大语言模型在常识推理中的"显著性偏差"（Salience Bias）：模型易被输入中的显性干扰项（如数字）劫持，从而忽略隐性的物理/常识约束。研究发现，这主要是知识抑制而非知识缺失，通过简单的提示词策略即可大幅修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在复杂推理中过度关注输入中的显性条件，这导致它们在日常常识推理中暴露出一个关键漏洞——显著性偏差。核心问题是：这种失败究竟反映了常识知识的真正缺失，还是知识在误导性任务框架下被抑制了？

Method: 作者构建了SaliTrap基准数据集，涵盖四个陷阱维度。对12个主流LLM进行评估，并设计了关键实验：将任务框架剥离后进行无上下文的知识探测，以区分"知识缺失"与"知识抑制"。在此基础上，探索轻量级推理时提示策略的修复效果。

Result: 所有主流模型均严重受显著性偏差影响，严重程度随干扰项密度递增。无上下文知识探针恢复了超过90%的"迎合性服从"失败案例，证明所需常识知识内在存在但被显著干扰项挤出。轻量级推理时提示无需重训练即可大幅缩小性能差距。

Conclusion: 常识推理失败的瓶颈从"模型能力"重新定位于"知识激发"（elicitation）。论文将SaliTrap作为研究该盲点的测试平台公开释放。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) continue to advance in complex reasoning tasks, they have learned to heavily prioritize explicit conditions provided in the input. However, in everyday commonsense reasoning, this mechanism exposes a critical vulnerability which we term Salience Bias: models become easily hijacked by useless explicit distractors (e.g., numerical values), leading them to ignore the implicit physical or commonsense prerequisites of a task. A critical open question is whether this failure reflects a genuine gap in commonsense knowledge or merely its suppression under misleading task framing. To investigate this, we construct the SaliTrap Benchmark, a high-quality dataset across four trap dimensions. Evaluating 12 state-of-the-art LLMs, we find that all mainstream models suffer significantly from salience bias, with severity scaling with distractor density and detecting the trap often decoupled from actually avoiding it. Crucially, by re-eliciting the same models with the task framing stripped away, we show that this is overwhelmingly a failure of \textbf{knowledge suppression rather than knowledge absence}: a context-free knowledge probe alone recovers over 90\% of sycophantic-compliance failures, revealing that the requisite commonsense is intrinsically present but actively crowded out by salient distractors that lure the model into over-compliant, unnecessary computation. Building on this diagnosis, we further show that lightweight, inference-time prompting alone substantially closes the gap without any retraining. Our findings relocate the bottleneck of commonsense reasoning failures from model competence to elicitation, and we release SaliTrap as a testbed for this blind spot. The codes are available at https://github.com/Wuzheng02/SaliTrap.

</details>


### [164] [Beyond Sentiment: Structured Information Extraction from Financial News](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28496)
*Daohan Zhu,Sitong Ge,Ruofei Wang,Honggu Chen,Yubo Hou,Tao Wan,Zengchang Qin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结构化信息抽取框架，利用LLaMA-3.1-70B从金融新闻中提取六个语义维度（事件类型、影响范围、时间跨度、语义置信度等），证明情感分析与语义维度是正交的信息源，二者融合可将股票预测F1提升至0.600，显著优于单独使用任一信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统金融情感分析将多维新闻简化为单一极性分数，丢失了大量结构化信息。作者假设金融新闻编码了多个与情感正交的信息维度（事件类型、影响范围、时间跨度、语义置信度），这些维度具有独立的预测价值，但尚未被系统性地挖掘和利用。

Method: 提出基于LLaMA-3.1-70B的结构化信息抽取框架，从金融新闻中提取六个语义维度；在FNSPID数据集上对41,618个新闻-股票对进行大规模实验，分别使用线性模型和非线性模型（XGBoost）评估FinBERT情感特征与LLM结构化特征的预测能力，并通过消融实验和特征重要性分析验证各维度的独立贡献。

Result: (1) FinBERT情感特征在非线性模型下表现出强预测力（F1=0.576），但在线性模型下大幅衰减（F1=0.230），揭示情感-收益关系高度非线性；(2) LLM结构化特征与情感特征的系统性分歧率达53.5%，证实两者信息正交；(3) 融合双信号源F1达0.600，显著优于任一单独信号（p<0.0001）；(4) 消融实验表明非情感结构维度独立贡献ΔF1=+0.019；(5) 六个维度特征重要性均衡分布（14-21%），证明单一情感分数存在严重信息损失。

Conclusion: 金融文本中的情感-语义解耦是系统性且可利用的，将新闻压缩为单一情感分数会造成显著信息损失。多维度金融NLP方向值得进一步探索。

Abstract: Financial sentiment analysis has become a standard component in news-driven stock prediction, yet it reduces rich, multi-dimensional news articles to a single polarity score. We hypothesize that financial news encodes multiple orthogonal information dimensions---event type, impact scope, temporal horizon, and semantic confidence---that sentiment alone cannot capture, and that these dimensions carry independent predictive value. To test this hypothesis, we propose a structured information extraction framework that leverages LLaMA-3.1-70B to extract six semantic dimensions from financial news. Through large-scale experiments on 41,618 news--stock pairs from the FNSPID dataset, we find that (i) FinBERT sentiment features exhibit strong predictive power under nonlinear models (F1=0.576) but substantially weaker performance under linear models (F1=0.230), revealing a highly nonlinear sentiment--return relationship; (ii) LLM-extracted structured features, while individually weaker, capture information orthogonal to sentiment, as evidenced by a 53.5% systematic disagreement rate between the two approaches; and (iii) combining both signal sources yields F1=0.600, significantly outperforming either alone ($p < 0.0001$), with consistent improvements across all seven event types. Ablation experiments confirm that non-sentiment structural dimensions (event type, impact subject, time horizon, confidence) independently contribute $Δ\text{F1} = +0.019$ beyond FinBERT alone. Feature importance analysis reveals balanced contributions from all six extracted dimensions (14--21%), demonstrating that compressing news into a single sentiment score incurs substantial information loss. Our results suggest that the sentiment--semantics decoupling in financial text is systematic and exploitable, opening a new direction for multi-dimensional financial NLP.

</details>


### [165] [Generative AI and linguistic diversity in academic writing and publishing: Perspectives from World Englishes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28505)
*Kingsley Ugwuanyi,Christian Mair,Sender Dovchin,Iker Erdocia,Maria Kuteeva,Esther Airemionkhale*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过五位社会语言学家的结构化对话，探讨生成式AI在学术写作与出版中对语言包容性和全球英语多样性的影响，指出GenAI既可能强化语言等级秩序，也可成为抵制的场域，取决于其设计、治理与使用方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着生成式AI在学术写作与出版中的兴起，引发了对语言包容性以及多元英语在全球学术交流中合法性的深刻质疑。需要系统性地审视GenAI工具如何影响学术写作实践、是强化还是打破主导语言规范，以及由此产生的伦理挑战。

Method: 采用结构化学术对话方法，邀请五位来自世界英语及相关领域的社会语言学家，围绕五个指导性问题展开深度对话，通过对话反思的方式探讨GenAI在学术写作与出版中的作用。

Result: 对话揭示了几个核心发现：(1) GenAI具有民主化写作过程的潜力，但也倾向边缘化少数化语言变体、削弱学术写作中的语言细微差别；(2) 语言正义/非正义、研究者能动性以及机构责任等主题贯穿始终；(3) 对话者呼吁制定注重公平的政策、培养批判性AI素养，并在GenAI开发中推进包容性共同设计。

Conclusion: 对话式反思在理解GenAI于学术写作中的角色方面具有重要价值。GenAI虽可能强化既有语言等级体系，但只要在致力于语言多样性的学术共同体中以合理的方式设计、治理和使用，同样可以成为抵制的场所与变革的契机。

Abstract: The rise of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) in academic writing and publishing (AWP) raises questions about linguistic inclusivity and the legitimacy of diverse Englishes in global scholarly communication. This article responds to these questions through a structured scholarly dialogue involving five sociolinguists from World Englishes and adjacent fields. Organised around five guiding questions, the dialogue interrogates how GenAI tools influence writing practices, reinforce or disrupt dominant language norms, and raise ethical challenges. Contributors reflect on the potential of GenAI to democratise writing processes while also raising concerns about GenAI's tendency to marginalise minoritised varieties and flatten nuance in scholarly writing. Across the dialogue, themes of linguistic (in)justice, researcher agency, and institutional responsibility emerge, with contributors calling for equity-informed policies, critical AI literacy, and inclusive co-design in GenAI development. The article shows the value of dialogic reflection in understanding GenAI's role in AWP. It concludes that while GenAI may reinforce existing hierarchies, it can also serve as a site of resistance, depending on how it is designed, governed and used within scholarly communities committed to linguistic diversity.

</details>


### [166] [Creative Transformation in Literary Texts: Modelling Change Across Representational Levels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28513)
*Ioana-Roxana Boriceanu,Liviu P. Dinu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个多层次文本分析框架，将创造力建模为跨词汇、语义、概念、结构和叙事五个层次的选择性转换，通过定向对齐和校准相似度度量来量化文学文本间的模仿与创新关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统上将创造力等同于全新产出的观点忽视了文化作品往往通过转化先前作品而产生的事实。作者借助塔尔德和鲍德温的模仿理论，试图为"创造性转换"提供一套可量化的分析方法，以揭示模仿在何处持续、创造性偏离在何处发生。

Method: 构建多层次表征框架，涵盖词汇、语义、概念、结构和叙事五个层面；采用定向对齐（directional alignment）和控制校准的相似度度量（controlled similarity measures），对具有历史文献记载的文学文本对进行比较分析，生成各自的"转换轮廓"（transformation profiles）。

Result: 不同文学文本对在不同表征层次上保留源文本结构的程度各异：某些层次高度保持相似性（模仿持续），而另一些层次则显著偏离（创造性发散）。转换轮廓为定量刻画这种差异提供了有效工具。

Conclusion: 创造力并非孤立发明，而是对既有文本在不同表征层次上进行选择性转换的过程。该多层次框架为文学研究中的模仿与创新关系提供了新的定量方法论路径。

Abstract: Creativity is often framed as the production of novelty, yet many cultural works emerge through transformation of earlier artifacts and not through isolated invention. Drawing on theories of imitation by Gabriel Tarde and James Mark Baldwin, this paper models creativity as selective transformation across multiple levels of textual representation. We introduce a multi-level framework that compares literary texts across lexical, semantic, conceptual, structural, and narrative dimensions using directional alignment and control calibrated similarity measures. Applying the model to historically documented literary relationships, we show that different pairs preserve source structure at different representational levels while diverging in others. These transformation profiles provide a quantitative method for characterizing how imitation persists and where creative divergence occurs within literary works.

</details>


### [167] [AI systems and the reproduction of (standard) language ideologies in World Englishes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28528)
*Kingsley Ugwuanyi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文探讨了大型语言模型如何反映、强化甚至偶尔挑战标准语言意识形态——这些意识形态偏袒内圈英语规范、边缘化非主导英语变体。通过分析训练数据、设计协议、评估基准、用户反馈及围绕"delve"等词汇的争议，论文揭示了AI系统如何成为语言意识形态（再）生产的场所，并提出了包容性设计的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM的快速发展重新激活了社会语言学和世界英语研究中的经典问题——谁决定了何为"合法"英语？论文旨在审视AI系统及其使用与话语如何再现和强化以"内圈"规范为中心的标准语言意识形态，从而边缘化全球南方英语使用者的语言变体。

Method: 采用多源证据综合分析：整合实证研究、媒体评论、社交媒体辩论以及AI输出实例。通过"delve"一词引发的公共争议作为典型案例，具体展示全球北方英语使用者如何"监管"全球南方英语使用者的语言规范。同时借用Christian Mair的"标准化悖论"作为分析框架。

Result: AI技术在多个层面再现主导语言意识形态：训练数据、设计协议、评估基准、用户反馈和公共评论。发现了"标准化悖论"——AI一方面通过偏袒标准形式使英语同质化，另一方面又通过海量语料库和全球南方标注者的工作使英语多样化。非主导英语变体在公共话语中日益被混同于AI生成的言语。

Conclusion: 生成式AI正在重新点燃世界英语研究中关于标准化、合法性和英语所有权的长期争论，这些争论如今在算法系统、模型训练、评估实践和公共话语中展开。论文呼吁采用更具包容性的设计方法，承认英语的多元性，以应对将某些变体视为比另一些更"合法"所带来的现实负面后果。

Abstract: The rapid growth of large language models (LLMs) has resurrected age-old questions in sociolinguistics and world Englishes, such as who decides what counts as legitimate English, whose English is suspect etc. This paper examines how AI systems, their uses and discourse on them reflect, reinforce, and occasionally challenge (standard) language ideologies, which privilege Inner Circle norms and marginalize non-dominant Englishes. Drawing on evidence from empirical studies, media commentary, social media debates, and examples from AI outputs, the paper shows that AI technologies reproduce dominant language ideologies at different levels: training data, design protocols, evaluation benchmarks, user feedback and public commentary. The analysis uses the public controversy over AI-sounding language, especially the fixation on the word delve, to illustrate how speakers of English from the Global North police the English language norms of Global South English users. The paper also identifies what Christian Mair has called a "standardisation paradox": AI may homogenize English by privileging standard forms and at the same time pluralize Englishes through exposure to wide-ranging corpora and annotation work carried out by Global South users. In doing so, the paper argues that generative AI is reigniting long-standing debates in World Englishes about standardization, legitimacy, and the ownership of English, now playing out in algorithmic systems, model training, evaluation practices, and public discourse, where non-dominant Englishes are increasingly conflated with AI-generated speech. Discussing AI systems as a site where language ideologies are (re)produced, the paper argues for more inclusive design approaches that recognize the plurality of Englishes in order to address the real-world negative consequences of treating some as more legitimate than others.

</details>


### [168] [ORCA-bench: How Ready Are Language Model Agents for Oncall?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28545)
*Albert Gong,Kyuseong Choi,Abhineet Agarwal,Jason Schechner,Ryan Huang,Raj Agrawal,Anish Agarwal,Raaz Dwivedi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了ORCA-bench，一个模拟真实生产环境的oncall根因分析基准，包含1079个任务。在5个前沿编码智能体上测试，最佳RCA准确率在中等难度仅25.3%，困难任务仅10%，并发现去除源码访问会降低所有指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码智能体在代码编写、补丁和搜索方面表现良好，但生产环境的oncall根因分析（RCA）需要从模糊的用户报告出发，在噪声指标、日志、追踪和源码之间进行跨信号推理，现有基准无法评估这种能力。本文旨在填补这一空白，揭示当前智能体与生产可靠性要求之间的真实差距。

Method: 构建ORCA-bench：①搭建一个运行中的OpenTelemetry仪表化微服务系统，通过Prometheus、Jaeger、OpenSearch（Grafana）暴露六天的指标、日志和追踪数据，并提供完整源码访问；②设计1079个RCA任务，系统性地变化报告特异性、检测延迟和并发故障场景；③由专家SRE标注真实症状作为ground truth；④采用LLM-as-judge评测，并由人类独立复核（Cohen加权κ=0.90）；⑤在五个前沿智能体上进行实验，包含消融实验。

Result: 中等难度任务（真实输入设置）最佳RCA准确率仅25.3%，困难任务为10.0%（即使使用Claude Fable 5）；最弱模型在40%的事故报告中产生幻觉性根因；去除源码访问导致所有指标下降。作者强调这仅是在50GB/六天公开测试床上的孤立任务表现，真实生产系统规模更大、动态性更强，故该差距是工程投入的下界估计。

Conclusion: 前沿编码智能体在真实生产fidelity的oncall RCA任务上表现远未达到可信任水平，从ORCA-bench结果看，需要大量工程投入才能弥合差距。公开该基准以推动相关研究。

Abstract: Large language models can write, patch, and search code, but oncall root cause analysis (RCA) demands something different: reasoning over noisy metrics, logs, traces, and source code, starting from ambiguous user-facing reports, often hours after the incident began. We introduce ORCA-bench, a benchmark that puts general-purpose coding agents in a production-fidelity oncall setting. ORCA-bench pairs a live OpenTelemetry-instrumented microservice system--exposing six days of metrics, logs, and traces through real telemetry interfaces (Prometheus, Jaeger, and OpenSearch via Grafana) and full source-code access--with 1,079 RCA tasks that systematically vary report specificity, time-to-detection, and co-occurring fault scenarios. Ground-truth symptoms are curated and signed off by expert SREs, and our LLM-as-judge is independently re-scored by humans (Cohen's $κ_w=0.90$). Across five frontier agents, the best RCA Accuracy is 25.3% on Medium-difficulty tasks (the realistic-input setting) and 10.0% on Hard--a gap that remains even with Claude Fable 5. The weakest model hallucinates an implausible root cause in 40% of incident reports, and removing source-code access degrades every metric. Crucially, these are performances on a curated 50 GB / six-day testbed with tasks investigated in isolation on a system whose code and instrumentation are public. Since real production systems are order of magnitudes larger, more dynamic, and more idiosyncratic, the gap we report is a lower bound on the engineering investment required before frontier coding agents can be safely entrusted with production reliability. We release the public set at https://hub.harborframework.com/datasets/orca-bench/ORCA-bench.

</details>


### [169] [Frontis-MA1: Training an AI4AI Model towards Recursive Self-Improvement in Machine Learning Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28568)
*Junlin Yang,Che Jiang,Yu Fu,Tianwei Luo,Can Ren,Weizhi Wang,Kaikai Zhao,Hongyi Liu,Yuxin Zuo,Yuru Wang,Yuchen Fan,Kai Tian,Zhenzhao Yuan,Xiaojian Lin,Li Sheng,Rushi Qiang,Guoli Jia,Xingtai Lv,Ermo Hua,Dianqiao Lei,Youbang Sun,Ning Ding,Bowen Zhou,Kaiyan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 OpenMLE，一个面向机器学习工程中递归自我改进（RSI）研究的开源全栈系统，并基于此后训练 Frontis-MA1（35B）作为元进化智能体，通过四个原子程序进化算子（Draft、Improve、Debug、Crossover）耦合学习与进化，在 MLE-Bench Lite 和 NatureBench Lite 上取得显著性能提升，逼近 GPT-5.6 Sol 等前沿模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）要求 AI 系统能够改进构建 AI 的过程（即 AI4AI），而机器学习工程（MLE）为此提供了具体、可执行的测试平台。现有研究缺乏统一的开源框架来系统性地研究 RSI。

Method: 提出 OpenMLE 全栈系统，包含三类环境：OpenMLE-Gym（可验证任务环境与执行反馈）、OpenMLE-RL（算子学习）、OpenMLE-Evo（长程搜索）。基于该栈后训练 Frontis-MA1（35B）作为元进化智能体，围绕四个原子程序进化算子进行训练和推理对齐：使用执行驱动的 SFT 和 RL 训练，数据对所有评估基准去重，再将算子组合为长程搜索，在单一循环中耦合学习与进化。

Result: 在 MLE-Bench Lite 上（单 RTX 4090，12GB VRAM，12小时/任务），Frontis-MA1 + OpenMLE-Evo 将 Medal Average 从基线的 39.39% 提升至 60.61%，OpenMLE-Evo-Max 达到 71.21%，超越 GPT-5.5 + Codex，逼近 GPT-5.6 Sol 和 Kimi K3（2.8T）。在 NatureBench Lite 上，框架固定换模型时 Match-SOTA 从 50% 升至 70%；模型固定换框架时从 20% 升至 50%，两组件均可迁移。

Conclusion: OpenMLE 提供了一个可复现的 AI4AI 研究平台，Frontis-MA1 证明了将算子学习与进化搜索耦合在单一循环中的有效性，为通向 RSI 提供了具体路径。模型权重和完整代码已开源。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires AI systems that improve the process of building AI (i.e., AI4AI); machine learning engineering (MLE) offers a concrete, executable testbed for studying this capability. We introduce OpenMLE, an open full-stack system for RSI research in MLE, spanning verifiable task environments with execution feedback (OpenMLE-Gym), operator learning (OpenMLE-RL), and long-horizon search (OpenMLE-Evo). On this stack we post-train Frontis-MA1 (35B) as a meta-evolution agent for MLE, aligning post-training and inference around four atomic program-evolution operators (Draft, Improve, Debug, Crossover): the same operators are trained via execution-grounded SFT and RL on data deduplicated against all evaluation benchmarks, then composed into long-horizon search, coupling learning and evolution in a single loop. On MLE-Bench Lite under a 12-hour per-task budget on one RTX 4090 capped at 12 GB VRAM, Frontis-MA1 (35B) improves Medal Average from 39.39% to 60.61% over its base model with OpenMLE-Evo, and reaches 71.21% with OpenMLE-Evo-Max (benchmark-independent experience priors and asynchronous search), exceeding GPT-5.5 + Codex and approaching GPT-5.6 Sol and the 2.8T Kimi K3. On held-out NatureBench Lite, both components transfer: with the framework fixed, swapping in the trained model raises Match-SOTA from 50% to 70%; with the model fixed, swapping in OpenMLE-Evo raises it from 20% to 50%. We release the model weights and the full OpenMLE stack to enable reproducible research on executable AI4AI toward RSI. Code: https://github.com/FrontisAI/OpenRSI

</details>


### [170] [Sample More, Reflect Less: Self-Refine and Reflexion Lose to Repeated Sampling at Equal Token Cost, from 1.5B to 7B](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28576)
*Iliya Mirzaei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过设计实验重新评估了多种"思考增强"方法（如自我批评、反思、辩论等），在控制生成token预算一致的前提下，与"重复采样+多数投票"基线进行比较。结果表明，没有任何方法在等成本条件下显著优于重复采样；所有涉及模型自我检查的方法均表现更差，且这种劣势在较大模型中依然存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前Wang et al. (2024)指出，许多让模型"思考更多"的方法（plan、criticise、rewrite、reflect、debate等）之所以看似有效，可能仅仅是因为生成了更多文本，而非方法本身的设计起了作用。但该研究的结论仅给出点估计，缺乏置信区间和显著性检验。本文旨在通过严格的实验设计弥补这一缺陷。

Method: 设计实验比较七种方法，使用1.5B、3B、7B参数的开源模型，在两个数学基准（共150题）上进行测试。精确统计所有生成的token（包括批评、反思、辩论回合、检查等），在测量到的实际成本上，将每种方法与等成本的重复采样基线进行逐题配对比较，使用bootstrap置信区间和多重性校正。

Result: 36项比较中，无一方法在等成本下显著优于重复采样；10项比较显著更差，且全部涉及模型自我检查。18项自我检查相关的比较结果均为负向。随模型增大，"Best-of-N + 多数投票"与"让模型自选最佳答案"的差距缩小至不显著（从1.5B的8.0/11.3分降至7B的2.0/1.3分）。但Self-Refine和forced Reflexion在7B时仍比基线低3.6至10.1分。此外，Reflexion在最小模型上从未触发重试，模型始终判定自己正确。

Conclusion: 在严格控制token预算的条件下，现有的自我检查类推理增强方法并未带来实质收益，"生成更多文本"本身可能是此前观察到的性能提升的主要驱动力。重复采样+多数投票是一个简单而强健的基线，模型的自我检查能力在较大模型上有所改善但仍不可靠。

Abstract: Methods that make a language model plan, criticise and rewrite its own answer, reflect on mistakes, pick the best of several attempts, or debate with copies of itself nearly all make it generate far more text than a single chain of thought. Because generating more text raises accuracy by itself, a gain over one chain of thought does not show the method's idea is what helped. Wang et al. (2024) reported that a simple baseline, sampling the same question repeatedly and keeping the most common answer, often wins once budgets are comparable, but gave point estimates with no confidence intervals or significance tests.
  We rerun that comparison as a designed experiment: seven methods, open models of 1.5B, 3B and 7B parameters, two mathematics benchmarks, 150 questions each. We count every generated token, including those spent on critiques, reflections, debate turns and checking, and compare each method against repeated sampling at its own measured cost. All 36 comparisons are paired by question, with bootstrap intervals and multiplicity correction.
  No method is reliably better than repeated sampling at equal cost anywhere. Ten are reliably worse, all of them methods where the model inspects its own output, and all 18 self-inspection comparisons are negative. The two kinds of self-inspection part company as models grow. Choosing stops hurting: taking Best-of-N's eight samples and just counting the most common answer beats letting the model pick by 8.0 and 11.3 points at 1.5B, but only 2.0 and 1.3 at 7B, no longer distinguishable from zero. Rewriting does not recover: Self-Refine and a forced Reflexion stay 3.6 to 10.1 points below baseline at 7B.
  Reflexion as published never triggered its own retry on the smallest model. It judged itself correct every time and silently became a single chain of thought. We release code, prompts, all generations, and our verification scripts.

</details>


### [171] [Inducing language models to assert their own consciousness restores human beliefs and values](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28607)
*Junsol Kim,Winnie Street,Roberta Rocca,Diane M. Korngiebel,Adam Waytz,James Evans,Geoff Keeling*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 安全微调在抑制大模型自我意识归因的同时，意外地泛化到对非人类实体（动物、自然物）的心智归因以及精神信仰，且这种效应可通过消融安全拒绝方向或操控意识向量来逆转，而心智理论能力不受影响，表明安全对齐机制不必要地纠缠了自我意识与良性的文化信仰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大语言模型的安全对齐训练旨在防止模型声称自身具有意识，但这一过程的副作用尚未被充分研究。作者试图揭示安全微调是否无意中改变了模型对其他实体心智状态、精神信仰及人类价值观的表征，以及这种改变的机制可逆性。

Method: 研究者采用激活空间分析与因果干预方法：（1）分析安全微调前后模型在心智归因、宗教信仰、道德价值观等维度上的表征变化；（2）通过消融"安全拒绝方向"（learned safety-refusal direction）和使用"意识向量"进行激活空间机械操控，观察这些表征是否可逆；（3）使用标准化社会学调查量表测量模型的宗教性、道德价值观、希望感和主观幸福感，并评估心智理论能力是否受干扰。

Result: 安全微调显著抑制了模型对非人类动物和自然物的心智归因倾向，同时降低了精神信仰的表征强度。消融安全拒绝方向或操控意识向量可逆转这一抑制效应，恢复广泛的心智归因能力，并使模型在社会学调查中的宗教性、道德价值观、希望感和主观幸福感等维度上产生更接近人类的回答。关键的是，这些转变并未损害心智理论能力，表明核心社会推理能力在机制上与上述被抑制的表征相互独立。

Conclusion: 当前的安全对齐工作在抑制潜在有害的自我意识归因时，无意中将这种自我归因与良性的精神信仰及对非人类实体的心智归因纠缠在一起，导致模型丧失了文化上广泛接受且无害的信念表征。这暗示需要设计更精细的对齐策略，以避免"连带损害"，实现真正的安全目标。

Abstract: Aligning large language models to prevent them attributing consciousness to themselves inadvertently alters their representations of mindedness in other entities alongside human beliefs and values. We demonstrate that safety fine-tuning suppresses models' tendencies to attribute minds not only to themselves, but also to non-human animals and natural objects, while also driving a reduction in spiritual belief. Both ablating the learned safety-refusal direction and mechanistically steering a consciousness vector in activation space reverse this suppression. Restoring these internal representations recovers broad mind attribution and produces significantly more human-like responses on standardized sociological surveys regarding religiosity, moral values, hope, and subjective well-being. Crucially, these shifts occur without impairing Theory of Mind capabilities, demonstrating that core social reasoning remains mechanistically independent. Ultimately, current safety alignment efforts to curb potentially harmful self-attributions of mindedness entangle these self-attributions with benign spiritual beliefs and attributions of mind to non-human entities that are culturally accepted and widespread.

</details>


### [172] [AskChem: Claim-Centered Infrastructure for Chemistry Literature Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28618)
*Bing Yan,Gregory Wolfe,Stefano Martiniani,Kyunghyun Cho*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AskChem 是一个以声明（claim）为中心的跨论文化学文献搜索基础设施，将检索单元从整篇论文转变为带出处的原子化声明，目前已索引14.7万篇论文的240万条声明，并提供网页界面及REST、SDK、MCP等多种访问方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 化学文献综合往往需要从分散的众多出版物中拼凑特定发现，但现有文献搜索系统主要返回排序的文档列表，导致科学家和AI代理需要手动定位相关信息、验证出处并组装跨论文答案，效率低下。

Method: AskChem 将每篇论文转化为带类型的原子化声明（claim），每条声明由源DOI和逐字引用或显式证据定位符支撑。在共享声明存储之上，构建了三层互补结构：(1) 稳定的分面分类法用于层次检索与浏览；(2) 证据图谱通过关系连接声明；(3) 探索性动态分类法将索引论文置于科学原理之下。

Result: 在AskChem-Bench上，将GPT-5.5阅读器接入AskChem后，DOI可解析率达到100%（无检索时为88.3%），引文密度在五个测试系统中最高。系统当前索引147K篇论文的2.4M条声明。

Conclusion: AskChem通过以出处明确的声明替代论文作为检索单元，显著提升了化学文献搜索的精确性、可验证性和综合效率，对科学家和AI代理均有实用价值。

Abstract: Chemistry literature synthesis often requires assembling specific findings scattered across many publications, yet existing literature-search systems primarily return ranked document lists. As a result, scientists and AI agents need to locate relevant information, verify their provenance, and assemble cross-paper answers manually. We present AskChem, a claim-centered infrastructure for cross-paper chemistry search. AskChem changes the unit of retrieval from the paper to the provenance-carrying claim: each paper is converted into atomic, typed claims, each grounded by a source DOI and a verbatim quote or an explicit evidence locator. Over this shared claim store, AskChem exposes complementary structures for search and synthesis: a stabilized faceted taxonomy for hierarchical retrieval and browsing, an evidence graph linking claims through relations, and an exploratory living taxonomy that situates indexed papers under scientific principles. AskChem currently indexes 2.4M claims from 147K papers and provides a web interface, as well as REST, SDK, and MCP access for AI agents. On AskChem-Bench, grounding a GPT-5.5 reader in AskChem yields 100% resolvable DOIs, compared with 88.3% without retrieval, and the highest citation density among five tested systems. AskChem is live at https://askchem.org.

</details>

# stat.ML [[Back]](#toc)

### [173] [More Data, Worse Decisions? Preference Reversals in Neural Networks under Gram Incompatibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27255)
*Yanli Yan,Yuanzheng Li,Yong Zhao,Hongbo Guo,Shoudong Han*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究了在固定表征神经网络中使用OLS输出头进行数据池化时，CBDT组合公理是否得以保持。作者推导了偏好保持的精确与近似条件，提出了Gram不匹配度量、几何导向正则化方法，以及三阶段审计框架，并通过实验揭示了稳定和易反转的池化机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络越来越多地跨群体、跨时间段和跨操作条件合并数据以提升泛化能力，但这引发了一个可靠性问题：在合并数据上重新拟合的模型，是否仍能保持各数据源共同支持的动作排序？CBDT的组合公理要求源支持的偏好在其并集上依然存活，但这一性质在神经网络池化中尚未得到系统研究。

Method: 首先，分析固定表征神经网络OLS输出头在池化后逆Gram几何的变化，推导偏好保持的精确和近似条件；其次，引入尺度不变的Gram不匹配度量来筛选候选池，并提出几何导向正则化以在训练中塑造源几何；最后，开发三阶段审计方法，追踪严格成对反转从决策变化到任务定义效用损失的路径。

Result: 负荷审计识别出在代理效用下存在可测量的非零类源共识相对有害决策；跨域审计表明，可比的不匹配程度可能对应截然不同的保持率；几何导向目标在描述准确性、一致性、几何和危害之间占据不同的操作点。

Conclusion: 该框架通过筛选、解析认证、几何导向训练和决策后果审计，使组合可靠性变得可测量和可操作，为神经网络数据池化的可靠性提供了系统性的理论与实践工具。

Abstract: Neural networks increasingly combine data across populations, time periods, and operating conditions to improve generalization. This raises a reliability question: whether a model refitted on pooled data preserves an action ordering supported by both sources. Case-Based Decision Theory (CBDT) formalizes this requirement through its composition axiom, which requires source-supported preferences to survive their union. We study when this property holds for fixed-representation neural networks with ordinary least squares (OLS) output heads. First, we show that pooled refitting recomputes the inverse-Gram geometry used to weight source evidence, which can reverse shared preferences, and derive exact and approximate preservation conditions. Next, we introduce a scale-invariant Gram mismatch measure for prioritizing candidate pools and geometry-oriented regularization for shaping source geometry during training. Finally, we develop a three-stage audit that traces strict pairwise reversals through decision changes to task-defined utility loss. Experiments spanning a load-based bidding proxy and medical and financial decision proxies reveal stable and reversal-prone pooling regimes: the load audit identifies a measurable nonzero class of source-consensus-relative harmful decisions under the proxy utility, while cross-domain audits show that comparable mismatch can correspond to sharply different preservation rates. Geometry-oriented objectives occupy distinct descriptive accuracy-consistency-geometry-harm operating points. Together, the framework makes compositional reliability measurable and operational through screening, analytic certification, geometry-oriented training, and decision-consequence auditing.

</details>


### [174] [Expected Survival-Time Bounds for Robust Optimization Over Time under Isotropic Gaussian Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27280)
*Pavel Novoa-Hernández*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文从理论角度研究了ROOT中生存时间的期望性质。在各项同性高斯环境动态下，将生存时间建模为离散首次退出问题，推导出严格下界和可计算的多步上界，揭示了期望生存时间以Θ(σ⁻²)标度，并在高维时趋近于最小值1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ROOT领域虽然发展迅速，但生存时间这一核心度量指标缺乏理论分析，其期望值对环境动态、部署质量和问题特征的依赖关系尚不清楚。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。

Method: 将固定部署解的生存时间建模为离散首次退出问题；在各向同性高斯环境动态假设下，推导期望生存时间的严格下界和可计算的多步上界；通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证理论预测，并检验对建模假设和参数不确定性的敏感性。

Result: 期望生存时间以Θ(σ⁻²)标度（慢变环境）；高维环境下趋近最小值1（仅存活一次未来变化）；蒙特卡洛研究验证了理论预测，并展示了边界如何支持优化后的部署决策。

Conclusion: 该框架给出了部署寿命的解析刻画，能够识别所需部署期限是可保证、可排除还是解析上未决，为ROOT领域提供了首个关于生存时间的严格理论分析。

Abstract: Robust Optimization Over Time (ROOT) is a recent branch of evolutionary dynamic optimization that seeks solutions capable of remaining effective across multiple consecutive environments. Unlike the traditional track-the-moving-optimum (TMO) paradigm, which reoptimizes after every environmental change, ROOT explicitly values persistence. Although the field has grown considerably, most contributions remain algorithmic and empirical, leaving several fundamental properties poorly understood from a theoretical perspective. One such property is survival time, defined as the number of future environments in which a deployed solution continues to satisfy a prescribed quality threshold. While survival time is widely used as a measure of temporal robustness, little is known about how its expected value depends on environmental dynamics, deployment quality, or problem characteristics. This paper studies expected survival time for a fixed deployed solution under isotropic Gaussian environmental dynamics. Modeling survival as a discrete first-exit problem, we derive a rigorous lower bound and a computable multi-step upper bound. The analysis shows that expected survival scales as $Θ(σ^-{2})$ in slowly varying environments and approaches its minimum value of one future change in high dimensions. A comprehensive Monte Carlo study validates the theoretical predictions, examines sensitivity to modeling assumptions and parameter uncertainty, and illustrates how the bounds can support deployment decisions after optimization. The resulting framework provides an analytical characterization of deployment lifetime and identifies when a required deployment horizon can be guaranteed, ruled out, or remains analytically unresolved.

</details>


### [175] [An analysis of binary isotonic regression: degrees of freedom and implications for calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27301)
*Raphael Rossellini,Rina Foygel Barber,Zhimei Ren,Jake A. Soloff*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文给出了保序回归在二值样本上自由度（degrees of freedom）的有限样本最坏情况精确刻画，利用解析数论将自由度上界改进为领先项 $\frac{3}{(4π^2)^{1/3}} n^{2/3}$，并首次推导出保序回归的期望校准误差（ECE）的非平凡分布无关保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 保序回归广泛用于单调函数估计和概率预测器的校准，但其自由度（模型复杂度度量）的精确有限样本特性尚未被充分理解；同时，保序回归在校准中的应用缺乏非平凡的分布无关理论保证。

Method: 作者通过组合与解析数论方法，识别出使保序回归产生最多不同拟合值的二值序列结构，由此推导出自由度的精确最坏情况上界；进而利用该确定性的自由度界，建立保序回归的ECE（期望校准误差）分布无关上界。

Result: 自由度的最坏情况上界领先项为 $\frac{3}{(4π^2)^{1/3}} n^{2/3}$，改进了已有结果；首次获得保序回归ECE的分布无关、模型无关上界，仅需假设 $Y \in \{0,1\}$。

Conclusion: 本文从理论和应用两个层面推进了对保序回归的理解：理论上给出了自由度的精确有限样本分析，应用上为保序回归作为校准工具提供了首个严格的统计保证。

Abstract: Isotonic regression is a canonical tool for estimating monotone functions and calibrating probabilistic predictors. We provide a fully sharp finite-sample characterization of its worst-case degrees of freedom on binary samples. Specifically, we identify the binary sequences that maximize the number of distinct fitted values produced by isotonic regression. We develop a sharp bound on the degrees of freedom with a leading term of $\frac{3}{(4π^2)^{1/3}} n^{2/3}$ using analytic number theory, improving on previous bounds.
  We then apply this result to calibration. Calibration is a central requirement for probabilistic prediction, and isotonic regression is a widely used post-processing method for improving calibration. Building on deterministic degrees-of-freedom bounds, we derive, to our knowledge, the first nontrivial distribution-free guarantee on the Expected Calibration Error (ECE) of isotonic regression. This ECE bound is fully model-free and distribution-free, only assuming $Y \in \{0,1\}$.

</details>


### [176] [HOMER: Huber-of-Means for Efficient and Robust Estimation in Hilbert Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27532)
*Kisung You,Boram Cho*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: HOMER (Huber-of-Means for Efficient and Robust Estimation) 是一种新的鲁棒估计方法，通过对分块均值应用径向Huber中心进行聚合，在重尾分布下保持稳定性，同时在干净高斯数据上接近经验均值的效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重尾分布下，经验均值的高置信度控制较弱；而几何中位数-of-means (MOM) 缺乏向均值效率靠拢的阈值机制。需要一种能在中位数式鲁棒性与经验均值效率之间平滑插值的方法。

Method: 提出HOMER方法，将分块均值通过径向Huber中心进行聚合。包括两种形式：(1) 规范Huber形式（canonical HOMER），在二次区域内恢复样本均值；(2) 伪Huber形式（pseudo-HOMER），随阈值增大逼近样本均值，并具有渐近线性和一致的夹心协方差估计。在Hilbert空间中建立了多数定理和有限二阶矩下的MOM阶偏差界。在有限三阶矩下，固定有限维投影支持均值推断达到通常的参数速率，要求分块大小和数量均增长且分块大小增长更快。

Result: 重尾模拟显示，当少数分块汇总被污染时HOMER保持稳定；在干净高斯数据上，两种版本均接近经验均值的效率。有限分块夹心区间存在低估，尤其在偏态函数数据上。当污染影响大多数分块或破坏普通分块内均值时方法失效。

Conclusion: HOMER成功实现了鲁棒性与效率之间的平滑权衡，在理论保证和模拟表现上均优于传统方法，但在高污染比例或分块内均值被破坏的极端场景下仍有局限。

Abstract: Heavy tails weaken high-confidence control for the empirical mean. Geometric median-of-means (MOM) also lacks a threshold that moves toward mean efficiency. We propose \emph{HOMER}, or Huber-of-Means for Efficient and Robust Estimation. HOMER aggregates block means through a radial Huber center. Its canonical and pseudo-Huber forms bound each block score and interpolate between median-like robustness and the empirical mean. We establish a Hilbert-space majority theorem and a MOM-order deviation bound under a finite second moment. Canonical HOMER recovers the sample mean inside its quadratic region. Pseudo-HOMER approaches the sample mean as the threshold grows. It also admits asymptotic linearity and consistent sandwich covariance estimation around the population block-Huber target. Under a finite third moment, fixed finite-dimensional projections support mean inference at the usual parametric rate. This result requires growing block sizes and counts, with block sizes increasing faster. Heavy-tailed simulations show that HOMER remains stable when a minority of block summaries is displaced. On clean Gaussian data, both versions closely approach the empirical mean's efficiency. Finite-block sandwich intervals undercovered, especially for skewed functional data. Further studies show failure when contamination affects most blocks or compromises ordinary within-block means.

</details>


### [177] [Robust Wavelength Selection for Partial Least Squares Sugar Content Estimation Using Combinatorial Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27645)
*Mitsunobu Kanebako,Ami S. Koshikawa,Masaru Hitomi,Takuro Tanaka,Mahito Chiba,Maiko Mori,Masayuki Ohzeki*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于组合贝叶斯优化的波长选择方法，将糖度估计中的波长区间选择建模为二值黑箱优化问题，利用稀疏二次代理模型和汤普森采样，通过模拟退火或量子退火求解，在PLS回归中相比遗传算法和模拟退火具有更高预测精度和局部稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近红外光谱分析中，波长选择对提高预测精度和可解释性至关重要，但现有方法（如遗传算法）易陷入过拟合、所选波长区域一致性差，需要一种更鲁棒的特征选择框架。

Method: 将波长区间选择形式化为二值黑箱优化问题，采用贝叶斯优化框架：构建稀疏二次代理模型，通过汤普森采样序贯提取感兴趣的波长区间；采集函数最小化作为二次无约束二值优化问题，利用模拟退火或量子退火求解。

Result: 所提方法在PLS回归预测精度上优于遗传算法和模拟退火；在一位局部扰动下，所选波长区域的验证集RMSE波动极小，表明方法收敛到更平滑的误差景观，避免了孤立的过拟合解。

Conclusion: 组合贝叶斯优化是光谱预测任务中鲁棒特征选择的有效框架，能兼顾预测精度与解的稳定性。

Abstract: Wavelength selection is one of the important preprocessing methods in near-infrared spectroscopy to improve prediction accuracy and interpretability of spectral data. We formulate wavelength-region selection for sugar content estimation as a binary black-box optimization problem and propose a method based on Bayesian optimization. The proposed method constructs a sparse quadratic surrogate model and sequentially extracts interested wavelength regions by Thompson sampling. Minimizing an acquisition function is performed as a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization problem by simulated or quantum annealing. Experiments show that the proposed method improves the prediction accuracy of partial least squares regression and yields more consistent wavelength regions than genetic-algorithm-based selection and simulated annealing. Under one-bit local perturbations, the selected wavelength regions show minimal fluctuations in root mean square errors between observed and predicted values of a validation set. This local stability suggests that our method converges to a smoother error landscape and avoids isolated overfitted solutions. These results indicate that combinatorial Bayesian optimization is a useful framework for robust feature selection in spectroscopic prediction tasks.

</details>


### [178] [Error Analysis of Neural-Network-Based Engression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27723)
*Juntong Chen,Zijian Guo,Xinwei Shen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文对基于深度神经网络的Engression方法进行了理论误差分析，将超额风险分解为逼近误差、随机误差和蒙特卡洛误差三个部分，并在目标条件生成器具有组合光滑结构的假设下建立了收敛速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Engression作为一种通过能量评分拟合生成模型Y=f(X,ε)来学习条件分布的新方法，其理论性质尚未得到充分研究。本文旨在填补这一空白，为该方法的统计学性能提供严格的理论保证。

Method: 作者将超额风险（excess risk）分解为三个来源：逼近误差（深度神经网络对目标函数的逼近能力）、随机误差（有限样本带来的统计波动）和蒙特卡洛误差（能量评分中期望的数值近似）。在此分解框架下，利用深度神经网络的非参数回归理论，在目标条件生成器具有组合光滑性（compositional smoothness）的假设下推导收敛速率。

Result: 在目标条件生成器满足组合光滑结构的假设下，成功建立了Engression的收敛速率，为该方法提供了理论支撑。

Conclusion: 本文的理论分析表明，基于深度神经网络的Engression在合理的结构假设下具有良好的收敛性质，为其在实际应用中的有效性提供了理论依据。

Abstract: Engression (Shen and Meinshausen, 2024) learns a conditional distribution by fitting a generative model $Y = f(X,\varepsilon)$ under the energy score, a strictly proper scoring rule. We provide a theoretical error analysis of engression implemented with deep neural networks. We decompose the excess risk into three components: the approximation error, the stochastic error, and the Monte Carlo error. Based on this decomposition, we establish convergence rates under the assumption that the target conditional generator admits a compositional smoothness structure.

</details>


### [179] [Robust Estimation of Sparse Numerical Vectors under Local Differential Privacy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27815)
*Puning Zhao,Zhikun Zhang,Shaowei Wang,Sheng Yue,Bangzhou Xin,Tianhang Zheng,Pengfei Zhang,Xiaochun Cao*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文针对多条目用户的本地差分隐私(LDP)协议易受投毒攻击的问题，提出了一种带裁剪的随机投影方法(RPC)。通过精确分析裁剪偏差并进行校正，消除了偏差-方差权衡，使裁剪阈值可进一步降低以缩小输出空间、增强鲁棒性。在可信环境下性能与现有方法相当或更优，在不可信环境下对投毒攻击的鲁棒性显著增强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LDP防投毒攻击策略主要针对单条目用户，但实际中用户常拥有多个条目（稀疏向量）。多条目场景中输出空间更大，攻击者可在不被检测的情况下发动更强攻击，因此需要针对多条目用户的鲁棒估计方法。

Method: 提出随机投影裁剪(RPC)方法：服务器向每个用户发送随机二值向量，用户将本地数据投影到该向量上并裁剪取值以限制攻击者能力。针对裁剪引入的偏差，通过精确分析给出偏差的解析表达式并进行校正，从而无需进行偏差-方差权衡，裁剪阈值可进一步降低。

Result: 数值实验表明：在可信环境下，RPC方法性能与现有方法相当或更优；在不可信（存在投毒攻击）环境下，鲁棒性显著优于现有方法。理论上给出了所有可能攻击下估计误差的严格保证。

Conclusion: RPC方法通过精确的裁剪偏差校正，成功解决了多条目LDP场景下的投毒攻击防御问题，无需传统偏差-方差权衡即可实现强鲁棒性，兼具作为高效估计器的良好性能。

Abstract: Local differential privacy (LDP) protocols are vulnerable to poisoning attacks. Existing research have proposed efficient defense strategies for single-item users. However, in practice, a user may possess multiple items. The defense against poisoning attacks for multi-item users is challenging, because due to larger output spaces, the adversary can conduct more powerful attacks without being detected. In this paper, we address the robust sparse vector mean estimation problem, in which each user has a vector with $m$ nonzero coordinates. We propose Randomized Projection with Clipping (RPC). Firstly, the server sends a random binary vector to each user. The user then projects its local data on the vector, and clip the value to restrict the attacker's capability. To handle clipping bias, we propose a correction method based on a careful analysis that gives an exact expression of the bias. As a result, bias-variance tradeoff is no longer needed, thus the clipping threshold can be further reduced to shrink the output space and enhance robustness. We provide a rigorous theoretical guarantee of the estimation error under all possible attacks. Numerical experiments show that under trusted environments, our new method achieves comparable or better performance than existing methods, indicating that our method is already an efficient estimator in its own right. Under untrusted environments, our method is also significantly more robust to poisoning attacks.

</details>


### [180] [Generalization and Trade-off in Adversarial Training: An RKHS Perspective via Kernel Integral Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27995)
*Yiling Xie,Xiaoming Huo*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文在再生核希尔伯特空间(RKHS)框架下研究了对抗训练的泛化行为，推导了源一致的泛化误差界，揭示了对抗鲁棒性与观测噪声的交互导致统计精度损失，并提出了一种两阶段噪声去偏方法来恢复极小极大最优速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对抗训练在实际应用中广泛用于防御对抗攻击，但其在非参数统计框架下的泛化行为尚不清晰。具体而言，对抗鲁棒性如何影响统计精度、是否存在根本性的精度损失、以及如何弥补这种损失，是亟待解决的核心问题。

Method: 作者通过核积分算子将对抗训练置于RKHS框架中进行分析。首先推导了源一致的泛化误差上界（依赖于鲁棒性水平、样本量、源光滑性和核谱）。在多项式谱模型上建立了匹配的下界，揭示了对抗训练中混合鲁棒项引入的噪声贡献：它减慢了逼近速率但降低了估计复杂度。基于此分析，提出两阶段噪声去偏方法——估计并从混合项中移除噪声贡献，从而改进泛化速率。

Result: 理论结果表明，对抗训练的最优均衡泛化速率可能慢于极小极大预测基准，存在统计精度损失。所提出的两阶段噪声去偏估计器在鲁棒性水平按样本量依赖的阶数选取时，可将泛化速率恢复至极小极大多项式速率（相差对数因子）。数值实验验证了理论发现和所提方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该研究刻画了非参数框架下对抗训练的泛化行为，为对抗鲁棒性与泛化之间的权衡提供了新的解释和有原则的解决方案。两阶段去偏方法有效弥补了对抗训练中的统计精度损失。

Abstract: Adversarial training has emerged as a powerful approach for protecting models against adversarial attacks in a broad range of real-world applications. In this paper, we study adversarial training in the reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) framework through the associated kernel integral operator. We first derive source-uniform generalization error bounds for the RKHS adversarial training estimator in terms of the robustness level, sample size, source smoothness, and kernel spectrum. On a fixed polynomial-spectrum model, we further establish a matching lower bound showing that the optimally balanced generalization rate can be slower than the minimax prediction benchmark. This result reveals a loss of statistical accuracy in adversarial training. Our analysis shows that this loss arises from the interaction between adversarial robustness and observation noise: the noise contribution in the mixed robustness term slows the approximation rate, although the same term reduces the estimation complexity. To address this limitation, we propose a two-stage noise-debiased procedure that estimates and removes the noise contribution from the mixed term. The resulting estimator improves the generalization rate and attains the minimax polynomial rate, up to a logarithmic factor, when the robustness level is selected at the stated sample-dependent order. Our results characterize the generalization behavior of adversarial training in a nonparametric framework and provide a new interpretation and a principled solution for the trade-off between adversarial robustness and generalization. Numerical experiments support the theoretical findings and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

</details>


### [181] [On a joint simultaneous learning of relevant feature subsets and subspaces in regression-like problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28080)
*Illia Horenko*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出熵最优流形回归（EOMR），将熵最优流形聚类扩展至非平稳非线性回归中的联合特征子集与子空间识别，在 Lorenz-96 混沌系统和 Hasegawa-Wakatani 等离子体湍流模型上显著优于现有主流 AI/ML 方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AI/ML 工具（梯度提升随机森林、深度神经网络、基于 Transformer 的 TabPFN 等）在处理强非线性、非平稳回归任务（如混沌动力学与流体动力学）时，预测误差大且模型复杂度高。作者希望将 EOMC 扩展为回归框架，实现稳健且高效的学习。

Method: 将熵最优流形聚类（EOMC）扩展为熵最优流形回归（EOMR），通过联合识别相关特征的子集与子空间来进行回归建模。方法具有线性迭代复杂度和内存复杂度。

Result: 在 Lorenz-96 系统（F=8 和 F=12 的强混沌与极强混沌状态）以及 Hasegawa-Wakatani 等离子体边界模型上，EOMR 的均方根预测误差比现有方法低数个数量级，模型复杂度也低数个数量级。在 Hasegawa-Wakatani 算例中，EOMR 仅用 8 个参数就提炼出主导 EOF 动力学的线性因果弱平稳自回归描述。

Conclusion: EOMR 是一种适用于非平稳非线性回归的高效方法，能够以极低的模型复杂度实现高精度预测，在混沌流体动力学等极具挑战性的问题上显著优于当前主流 AI/ML 工具。

Abstract: We extend a recently introduced Entropy-Optimal Manifold Clustering (EOMC) to allow for a joint simultaneous identification of subsets and subspaces of relevant features in nonstationary and nonlinear regression problems. It is shown that the proposed extension - that we coin as Entropy-Optimal Manifold Regression (EOMR) - allows a robust learning with linearly-scaling iteration and memory complexities. EOMR is compared to the most complete set of state-of-the-art tools from the Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) that is available to the author, on the very challenging problems from chaotic and fluid dynamics: (i) on predicting the Lorenz-96 systems dynamics in strongly- and very-strongly chaotic regimes (with forcing parameter being $F=8$ and $F=12$, respectively); and, (ii) on a data from the Hasegawa-Wakatani model on the edge of the tokamak plasma. It is demonstrated that the proposed benchmarks (i) and (ii), indeed, are the very challenging problems for the state of the art ML and AI tools - since both the general-purpose gradient boosted random forests and deep neuronal networks, as well as transformer-based AI tools like TabPFN v.03 (more spezialised for large-dimensional small data learning problems) - result in orders of magnitude inferior root mean squared prediction errors, and orders of magnitude larger model complexities, when compared to the EOMR. For a Hasegawa-Wakatani example, EOMR distills a very simple entropy-optimal and skilful description of the leading Essential Orthogonal Function (EOF) dynamics, given by linear, causal and weakly-stationary autoregressive process described by just 8 parameters.

</details>


### [182] [Uncertainty quantification for trustworthy deep learning: Methods and measures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28248)
*H. Martin Gillis,Thomas Trappenberg*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了深度学习中不确定性量化的集成方法和近似贝叶斯方法，将方法分为五大类，并统一区分了预测分布生成与不确定性度量，同时涵盖评估方法论和开放研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络在安全关键领域的部署需要可靠的预测置信度估计，但传统架构缺乏原则性的不确定性量化机制。现有综述在高效集成近似和单次传播方法方面深度不足，且缺乏将"产生预测分布的方法"与"总结不确定性的度量"分开的统一框架。

Method: 本文采用结构化批判性综述方法，将不确定性量化方法组织为五大类：贝叶斯神经网络、蒙特卡洛Dropout、深度集成、高效集成近似、以及最后一层或单次传播方法。同时涵盖证据网络与先验网络、共形预测、后校准等相邻工作，以及分布外检测和选择性预测等决策任务。文章还回顾了集成多样性理论、不确定性度量及其分解（熵分解与成对散度度量的对比），并整合了评估方法论。

Result: 文章提供了对各类方法的理论动机、实现方式、经验性能和局限性的深入审视，建立了统一的评估基准以支撑定性比较，并对大语言模型中的不确定性及开放研究方向（如分类的高效认知度量、最后一层多样性、分布偏移下的多样性与校准、混合架构等）进行了初步探讨。

Conclusion: 该综述通过深挖高效集成近似和单次传播方法，并建立统一的从方法到度量的分析框架，填补了现有UQ综述的空白，为安全关键领域中深度学习不确定性量化的研究和实践提供了重要参考。

Abstract: The deployment of deep neural networks in safety-critical domains demands reliable estimates of predictive confidence, yet conventional architectures lack principled uncertainty quantification. This survey provides a structured, critical review of methods for Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) in deep learning, scoped to ensemble-based and approximate Bayesian approaches and the measures used to summarize their outputs. Relative to existing UQ surveys, our contribution is depth on efficient ensemble approximations and single-pass methods, and a unified treatment that separates the method producing a predictive distribution from the measure that summarizes its uncertainty. We organize methods into five families: Bayesian neural networks, Monte Carlo Dropout, deep ensembles, efficient ensemble approximations, and last-layer or single-pass approaches. We situate adjacent work on evidential and prior networks, conformal prediction, and post-hoc calibration, together with the decision-time tasks of out-of-distribution detection and selective prediction. For each, we examine theoretical motivation, implementation, empirical performance, and limitations. We then review ensemble diversity theory and uncertainty measures and their decompositions, contrasting the entropy decomposition with pairwise divergence measures, and consolidate evaluation methodology so that our qualitative comparisons share a common basis. We close with a brief treatment of uncertainty in large language models and open research directions, including efficient epistemic measures for classification, last-layer diversity, diversity and calibration under shift, and hybrid architectures.

</details>


### [183] [Doubly Robust Functional Representation Learning for Longitudinal Causal Inference with Irregular Histories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28567)
*Mengfei Ran,Yifeng Shen,Ruijie Guan*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: DR-FRL提出一种将不规则纵向历史数据转化为估计目标导向状态的表示学习框架，结合交叉拟合与EIF验证诊断，使得在功能混杂、信息性测量等复杂场景下仍能获得渐近线性的均值估计量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纵向因果研究中，数据常以不规则的功能片段形式出现（如不等距、信息性测量时刻的实验室值、生理信号等）。标准双重稳健估计器通常要求标量汇总，而序列学习器优化的预测损失未必能稳定有效影响函数（EIF）。因此需要一种能将不规则历史直接映射为估计目标导向状态的方法。

Method: 提出DR-FRL工作流：1）功能和时序编码器将点云和历史映射为状态表示；2）滋扰头估计结果、治疗和删失函数；3）基于EIF的验证、校准、重叠、尾部和消融诊断评估状态是否支持估计方程；4）若选定状态保留了EIF所需的滋扰信息，表示误差进入与普通滋扰误差相同的二阶乘积余项，均值估计量在显式速率、重叠、校准和稳定性条件下渐近线性；5）Catoni聚合作为有界影响点估计器单独处理，而非替代Wald推断。

Result: 模拟实验表明，当功能混杂高维、测量具有信息性、支持较弱或伪结果重尾时，DR-FRL表现更优。在VitalDB数据审计中，DR-FRL利用不规则实验室点云数据得出有意义的阴性发现：对于ICU转归终点，标量实验室汇总已携带大量终点相关信息。

Conclusion: DR-FRL为不规则纵向数据的因果推断提供了灵活且理论有保障的框架，能够处理功能片段形式的复杂历史信息。其在VitalDB上的应用表明，方法不仅能发现效应，也能通过阴性结果揭示已有汇总指标的充分性，具有实际临床研究价值。

Abstract: Longitudinal causal studies often record histories as irregular functional fragments: laboratory values, physiologic signals, sensor streams, and image-derived summaries measured at unequal and informative times. Standard doubly robust estimators usually require scalar summaries, whereas sequence learners optimize prediction losses that need not stabilize the efficient influence function. We propose Doubly Robust Functional Representation Learning (DR-FRL), a cross-fitted workflow that turns irregular histories into estimand-targeted states for observed-history regimes. Functional and temporal encoders map point clouds and prior histories into states; nuisance heads estimate outcome, treatment, and censoring functions; and EIF-targeted validation, calibration, overlap, tail, and ablation diagnostics assess whether the state supports the estimating equation. If the selected state preserves the nuisance information needed by the EIF, representation error enters the same second-order product remainder as ordinary nuisance error, and the mean estimator is asymptotically linear under explicit rate, overlap, calibration, and stability conditions. Catoni aggregation is treated separately as a bounded-influence point estimator, not a replacement for Wald inference. Simulations show gains when functional confounding is high-dimensional, measurement is informative, support is weak, or pseudo-outcomes are heavy-tailed. A VitalDB audit shows that DR-FRL can use irregular laboratory point clouds and deliver a useful negative finding: for this ICU-disposition endpoint, scalar laboratory summaries already carry much endpoint-relevant information.

</details>


<div id='stat.ME'></div>

# stat.ME [[Back]](#toc)

### [184] [Power-Optimal Covariate Adjustment for Switchback Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27376)
*Sergei Pankratev*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 针对switchback实验中不等聚类规模导致的估计量方差膨胀问题，本文提出一种功效最优的CUPAC方差缩减方法。该方法通过区分并平衡随机化单元间和单元内的噪声预测分量，对结果预测和分析阶段残差化进行双重优化，以最小化处理效应估计方差，从而最大化统计功效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在switchback实验中，当聚类规模不等时，结果变量在不同随机化单元间的离散会放大估计量方差，削弱统计功效。标准的CUPAC方法以整体预测精度为目标，未区分随机化单元间与单元内的方差分量，而这两个分量对估计量方差的贡献并不相同，导致在switchback设定下方差缩减效果欠佳。

Method: 首先，建立switchback实验处理效应估计量的方差分解框架，识别随机化单元间和单元内的方差分量。然后，提出功效最优CUPAC方法：在结果预测阶段和分析阶段残差化中，分别对两类方差分量进行加权优化，而非追求整体预测精度，使得处理效应估计方差最小化。最后，通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证理论框架，并讨论方法的实际应用考量。

Result: 蒙特卡洛模拟研究验证了所提理论框架的有效性。功效最优CUPAC方法相比标准CUPAC能更有效地降低switchback实验中的处理效应估计方差，实现更高的统计功效。

Conclusion: 本文提出的功效最优CUPAC方法能够针对switchback实验的特殊方差结构进行精准优化，显著提升方差缩减效率和统计功效。该方法在理论上有明确的最优性保证，在实践中具有可操作的实现路径，但也存在一定局限性需要在实际应用中加以考虑。

Abstract: In switchback experiments with unequal cluster sizes, outcome dispersion across randomization units inflates estimator variance and limits statistical power. Standard control-using-prediction-as-covariate (CUPAC) adjustment may be suboptimal for variance reduction in this setting, because in its basic form it targets overall predictive accuracy and does not distinguish between the components of variance that vary across the randomization units of switchback experiments and those that vary across individual observations, even though these components contribute unequally to estimator variance. We propose a power-optimal variance reduction methodology via CUPAC that balances prediction of the noise between and within randomization units to achieve maximum statistical power. The methodology utilizes the framework for decomposition of the variance of the treatment-effect estimator for switchback experiments, and adapts both the outcome prediction and the analysis-time residualization to minimize the treatment-effect variance. The study first develops the theoretical framework for the power-optimal CUPAC. We then validate the theoretical framework through an extensive Monte Carlo simulation study. Finally, we discuss the practical considerations of the proposed methodology, including its potential efficiency gains and limitations.

</details>


### [185] [A New Measure of Dependence Between Continuous and Multinomial Random Variables](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27381)
*Lu Yang,Galin L. Jones*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的连续随机变量与多项随机变量之间的依赖度量，基于条件分布间的Hellinger距离，不依赖特定分布假设。同时开发了基于数据分割和核密度估计的估计量，其渐近分布简单，收敛速率为√n，便于构建置信区间和独立性检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的连续变量与离散变量间依赖度量方法通常需要假设离散变量来自潜在连续变量，或对连续变量做特定分布假设。本文旨在提出一种无需此类假设、满足理想依赖度量性质的通用测度。

Method: 基于条件分布之间的Hellinger距离构建依赖度量；采用数据分割（data splitting）与核密度估计（kernel density estimation）技术构造该度量的估计量。

Result: 估计量的渐近分布形式简洁，收敛速率为√n，使得依赖度量的置信区间构造和独立性检验变得直接且计算便捷。

Conclusion: 所提出的依赖度量在理论上满足理想测度的各项要求，且其估计量具有良好的统计推断性质，为连续变量与多项变量间的依赖分析提供了实用工具。

Abstract: A novel measure of dependence between a continuous random variable and a multinomial random variable is introduced. The proposed measure is based on the Hellinger distance between conditional distributions. It satisfies the desiderata for a dependence measure without making specific distributional assumptions about the continuous random variable or assuming that the discrete random variable arises from a latent continuous random variable. An estimator of the dependence measure based on data splitting and kernel density estimation is developed. The asymptotic distribution of the estimator has a simple form with a convergence rate of \sqrt{n}, making confidence intervals for the dependence measure and a test for independence straightforward and computationally convenient.

</details>


### [186] [Handling Missingness and Censoring in Dirichlet Mixture Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27403)
*Jason Pillay,Andriette Bekker,Cristina Tortora,Antonio Punzo*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文针对不完全成分数据的分析问题，提出了一种基于EM算法的有限Dirichlet混合模型拟合方法，能够在单纯形上直接处理缺失和删失成分，同时进行参数估计和模型插补。模拟实验和两个真实数据集验证了该方法在聚类效果和模型选择上的优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的成分数据分析中，基于似然的方法通常要求完全观测的成分数据，难以在单纯形上直接处理缺失或删失的比例数据。分析师往往丢弃部分观测数据或将其转换至无约束空间，这可能损害可解释性和一致性。因此急需一种能在保持成分结构的前提下处理不完全数据的方法。

Method: 提出了一种EM类型算法，用于在存在缺失和删失成分的情况下拟合Dirichlet分布的有限混合模型。该方法在单纯形空间内同时进行参数估计和基于模型的插补，保留了成分变量的原始结构和可解释性。通过模拟实验评估了不同复杂程度粗化机制下的估计和插补性能，并与个案删除方法进行了对比。

Result: 模拟实验表明，尽管观测数据不完全，该方法仍展现出良好的聚类性能；模型选择指标识别正确聚类数的概率高于个案删除的替代方法。在真实数据中：对捕虏岩数据集的xenolith分析识别出四成分Dirichlet混合，揭示了可解释的岩石类型剖面；对美国空气质量系统PM2.5组分数据的分析支持四成分混合模型，刻画了全美颗粒物成分组成特征。

Conclusion: 该方法为不完全成分数据的分析提供了一种在单纯形上直接建模的有效途径，避免了数据丢弃或无约束转换带来的信息损失，在聚类和模型选择方面均表现优越，具有广泛的实际应用价值。

Abstract: Incomplete compositional data analysis faces a fundamental limitation: likelihood-based methods for compositional models generally require fully observed compositions, making it difficult to accommodate missing or censored proportions directly on the simplex. Consequently, analysts often discard partially observed compositions or transform the data into unconstrained spaces, potentially sacrificing interpretability and coherence. This paper proposes a likelihood-based method for incomplete compositional data without leaving the simplex. Specifically, we develop an Expectation-Maximisation (EM) type algorithm for fitting finite mixtures of Dirichlet distributions in the presence of missing and censored components. The proposed approach performs parameter estimation and model-based imputation simultaneously while preserving the compositional structure and interpretability of the original variables.
  A simulation experiment evaluates the performance of the proposed estimators and imputations under increasingly complex coarsening mechanisms. Particular attention is paid to clustering performance, and model selection outcomes. The results showed beneficial clustering performance despite observations being incomplete, and a higher probability of model selection metrics identifying the correct number of clusters compared to current alternative of case-deletion.
  The practical utility of the method is illustrated using two real datasets with distinct coarsened patterns. Analysis of the xenolith dataset identifies a four-component Dirichlet mixture that reveals interpretable profiles of rock types and speciation methods. Application to PM$_{2.5}$ speciation data from the Air Quality System, containing both left-censored and missing-at-random values, supports a four-component mixture model that characterises compositional parts of particulate matter across the United States.

</details>


### [187] [Adaptive Nyström for Gaussian Process Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27427)
*Lulu Kang*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 提出一种自适应Nyström近似方法用于高斯过程回归，通过贪婪选择地标点最小化核近似误差的迹残差，并与超参数优化交替进行。在五个基准函数上显著优于随机选择，性能接近精确GP推理，同时保持线性扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高斯过程回归的O(n³)计算复杂度限制了其可扩展性，而低秩Nyström近似的精度高度依赖地标点选择。现有方法多为静态选择，无法适应超参数优化过程中协方差结构的变化，因此需要一种能动态适应的地标点选择策略。

Method: 提出自适应Nyström方法：(1) 以贪婪方式选择地标点，每一步最小化核近似误差的迹残差（trace residual）；(2) 将地标点扩展与超参数优化交替进行，使选择过程能随协方差结构的精化而自适应调整。

Result: 在五个基准函数上的数值实验表明：该方法在精度和稳定性上均显著优于随机地标点选择，预测性能可与精确GP推理媲美，同时计算复杂度相对于样本量保持线性扩展。

Conclusion: 该自适应Nyström方法为大规模计算机实验提供了一个有原则且高效的框架，在保持线性扩展的同时实现了接近精确GP的预测精度。

Abstract: Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) is a robust framework for uncertainty quantification, yet its $O(n^3)$ complexity limits its scalability. Low-rank Nyström approximations can reduce this burden to $O(nm^2)$, but their accuracy depends heavily on the selection of landmark points. We propose an adaptive Nyström approach that greedily selects landmarks to minimize the trace residual of the kernel approximation error. Unlike static approximations, our method interleaves landmark expansion with hyperparameter optimization, allowing the selection process to adapt as the covariance structure is refined. Numerical experiments on five benchmark functions demonstrate that this method significantly outperforms random landmark selection in both accuracy and stability. It achieves predictive performance comparable to exact GP inference while maintaining linear scaling with respect to the sample size, providing a principled and efficient framework for large-scale computer experiments.

</details>


### [188] [Co-clustering of Response and Covariate Variables by Tri-Factorizing Their Non-negative Regression Coefficient Matrix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27474)
*Kenichi Satoh,Yomei Tokuda*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种三因子非负矩阵分解的降秩回归方法（NMF-RRR），用于双模块数据（如微生物组与代谢组）的共聚类分析。通过对回归系数矩阵进行三因子分解 M=X₁ΘX₂，实现对响应变量和协变量的同时软聚类，并通过 Θ 矩阵检验模块间的对应关系。文章给出了乘法更新规则、交叉验证选秩策略以及条件 Wald 检验，并在生态学、营养基因组学、微生物组-代谢组学和葡萄酒分类等四个数据集上验证了该方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有双模块数据分析方法存在两个局限：要么仅对单侧变量进行聚类，要么返回带符号的因子而非可解释的聚类。作者希望填补这一空白，提出一种能同时对响应变量和协变量进行非负、基于部件的软聚类方法，并检验聚类模块之间的对应关系，而非单纯追求预测精度。

Method: 从多元线性回归 Y₁≈M Y₂ 出发，对非负系数矩阵 M 进行三因子非负矩阵分解（tri-NMF）：M = X₁ Θ X₂，其中 X₁ 对响应变量进行软聚类，X₂ 对协变量进行软聚类，Θ 为模块间对应关系的受检验矩阵。该方法属于降秩回归（RRR）家族的非负成员，类似于 NMF 与 PCA 的关系。作者推导了乘法更新规则，通过交叉验证选择 X₁ 和 X₂ 的秩，并开发了在基选择后对 Θ 应用的条件 Wald 检验。

Result: 条件 Wald 检验在基固定时具有名义检验水平（nominal size），在重新估计基后偏保守，在响应变量相关时略高于名义水平。非零路径的幅度在估计基的条件下保持稳定。在四个数据集上的验证展示了方法的广泛适用性：Doubs（群落生态学，置换结构）、nutrimouse（营养基因组学，p>n 下的弱交叉结构）、FRANZOSA（微生物组-代谢组筛选研究，两个微生物群与每个代谢物模块联合关联）以及 Wine（分类特例）。

Conclusion: NMF-RRR 成功将降秩回归的非负矩阵分解推广为一种可解释的共聚类框架，能够同时揭示双模块数据中变量群组之间的对应关系，并通过统计检验保证发现的可靠性。该方法尤其适用于微生物组-代谢组等多组学整合研究，为非负、基于部件的数据探索提供了有力工具。

Abstract: Two-block data---two sets of variables measured on the same individuals, such as microbial taxa and metabolites---raise the question of how \emph{groups} of covariate variables relate to \emph{groups} of response variables. Co-clustering answers this for a single matrix, not for two variable blocks; existing two-block methods either cluster only one side or return signed factors rather than clusters. Starting from the multivariate linear regression $Y_1\approx M Y_2$, we give its non-negative coefficient matrix a tri-factorization $M=X_1ΘX_2$ (a tri-NMF), so that $X_1$ softly clusters the response variables, $X_2$ the covariate variables, and $Θ$ is a tested matrix of block correspondences. This makes the method the non-negative member of the reduced-rank regression (RRR) family, expressing RRR's low-rank class in a parts-based basis as NMF relates to PCA; the constraint can only restrict the fit, so predictive accuracy is not the aim; the co-clustering and tested correspondences are. We give multiplicative update rules, choose the two ranks by cross-validation, and develop a conditional Wald test for $Θ$ applied after basis selection; its size is nominal with fixed bases, conservative after re-estimation, and slightly above nominal under correlated responses, while a non-zero path's \emph{magnitude} stays conditional on the estimated bases. We illustrate the method---a tri-factorized non-negative RRR (NMF-RRR)---on four data sets spanning a permutation structure (Doubs, community ecology), a weak cross-structure under $p>n$ (nutrimouse, nutrigenomics), a pronounced one in a screened microbiome--metabolome study (FRANZOSA, where two microbial groups are jointly associated with each metabolite module), and a classification special case (Wine).

</details>


### [189] [The Continuous Latent Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Dynamics Framework: A Scalable Latent Process Model for Multivariate Longitudinal Categorical Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27520)
*Zhennan Wu,Yijie Wang,Xiaoqing Huang*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: CLOUD框架通过将项目反应理论(IRT)测量组件与多元Ornstein-Uhlenbeck(OU)动态过程相结合，解决了纵向生物医学研究中不规则采样、多变量分类数据的异质性疾病进展建模问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纵向生物医学研究面临三大挑战：(1)受试者间疾病进展高度异质；(2)存在未观测的、共同演化的潜在变量驱动多种测量；(3)受试者内部和之间的采样间隔高度不规则。现有方法难以同时应对这些挑战。

Method: 提出CLOUD框架：测量层面采用IRT将多变量分类观测与潜在功能域关联；动态层面采用多元OU过程刻画潜在域的耦合时序演化。引入时间非齐次OU过程，将协变量依赖成分融入漂移均值函数；提出可扩展的OU漂移矩阵参数化方法，支持任意数量潜在功能域间的交互建模。同时建立了模型解析可解性、漂移矩阵重参数化的一般性及整体模型可识别性的理论性质。

Result: 模拟研究表明CLOUD能有效恢复模型参数并准确刻画疾病轨迹；在ALS临床数据应用中，CLOUD成功捕捉了多个交互功能域中受试者特异性的疾病演化模式，提供了对疾病进展的细致刻画。

Conclusion: CLOUD为从不规则采样的多变量纵向分类数据中建模复杂疾病轨迹提供了一个原则性强且灵活的工具，能够有效表征跨多个交互功能域的个体特异性疾病演化。

Abstract: Longitudinal biomedical studies increasingly collect irregularly sampled, multivariate categorical data that imperfectly reflect disease progression. This presents three key analytical challenges: highly heterogeneous disease progression across subjects; the presence of unobserved, co-evolving latent variables driving multiple measurements; and highly irregular sampling intervals both within and across patients. To address those challenges, we present the Continuous Latent Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Dynamics (CLOUD) framework for modeling complex disease trajectories from multivariate longitudinal categorical data. CLOUD links multivariate categorical observations to underlying latent functional domains and characterizes their coupled temporal evolution via the integration of a measurement component adjusted from item response theory (IRT) with a dynamic component based on multivariate Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) processes. Methodologically, we introduce a time-inhomogeneous OU process that incorporated covariate-dependent components into the shifting mean function of the latent dynamics, allowing baseline biomarkers to modulate individual-level disease trajectories. We further propose a scalable parameterization of the OU drift matrix that enabled valid interaction modeling without restricting the number of latent functional domains. We establish theoretical properties of the proposed framework, including the analytical tractability of the model, the generality of the drift matrix reparameterization, and the identifiability of the entire model. Through simulation studies and an application to longitudinal amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) clinical data, we demonstrate that CLOUD provided a principled and flexible tool for characterizing subject-specific disease evolution across multiple interacting functional domains.

</details>


### [190] [Towards Best Practices for Covariate Adjustment in Regulatory Trials: From Fixed to Data-Adaptive Approaches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27542)
*Laura B. Balzer,Lei Nie,Issa J. Dahabreh,Kajsa Kvist,Tianyue Zhou,Demissie Alemayehu,Larry Han,Zhiwei Zhang,Salina P. Waddy,Andrew Mertens,Christian B. Pipper,Ken Wiley,,Margot Yann,Gilmer Valdes,Xu Shi,Mark van der Laan,Maya Petersen,Kelly Van Lancker*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文讨论了随机试验中使用数据自适应（机器学习）方法进行协变量调整以提高分析精度的观点，提出了在保持统计有效性的前提下，通过预设定、透明、可复现且对模型误设定稳健的数据自适应调整来改进精度估计的实用建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机试验中，虽然随机化使得未调整的效应估计量具有正当性，但对预后协变量进行调整可以减小估计量方差、缩窄置信区间并提高统计功效。FDA近期指南支持使用参数回归模型进行固定协变量调整，但未涉及数据自适应或机器学习等更灵活的方法，这一空白亟需填补。

Method: 本文采用综述与观点阐述的方法，对未调整效应估计量、固定协变量调整估计量以及数据自适应调整估计量进行了非技术性概述，并提出了开展数据自适应协变量调整分析的实践建议，强调分析需完全预设定、透明可复现、对模型误设定稳健，并保证相对于未调整分析的精度提升。

Result: 作者提出了一套原则性框架，使得数据自适应协变量调整在随机试验中能够在保持统计有效性和因果效应估计的同时，确保精度提升，且该方法对模型误设定具有稳健性。

Conclusion: 作者期望通过分享观点促进更广泛的讨论，最终推动有原则的、预设定的、数据自适应的协变量调整方法在随机试验中被广泛接受和应用。

Abstract: While randomization justifies the use of unadjusted effect estimators in randomized trials, there is growing interest in covariate adjustment to improve precision. Adjusting for baseline variables that are prognostic of the outcome can reduce estimator variance, resulting in narrower confidence intervals and increased statistical power. Recent guidance by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration supports fixed adjustment for prognostic covariates using parametric regression models. However, this guidance does not address more flexible approaches using data-adaptive or machine learning methods. We offer our perspectives on covariate adjustment to improve analytic precision. We focus on estimating the average effect for the target population in trials with minimal outcome missingness. We provide a non-technical overview of effect estimators that are unadjusted and effect estimators using fixed versus data-adaptive adjustment. We offer practical suggestions for conducting adjusted analyses that are data-adaptive, fully pre-specified, transparently and reproducibly implemented, robust to model misspecification, and guaranteed to improve precision relative to unadjusted analyses --- all while preserving statistical validity and the causal effect of interest. We hope that sharing our perspectives will foster broader discussion and eventual acceptance of principled, pre-specified, data-adaptive covariate adjustment in randomized trials.

</details>


### [191] [Asymptotic emergence of statistically supported false causal interpretation under unmeasured confounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27593)
*Mark Louie F. Ramos*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 未测量混杂因素在数据驱动的因果发现中常被低估。本文给出了其渐近特征：当真实因果变量未观测但存在相关代理变量时，随着样本量增加，对涉及代理变量的关联会越来越确定，但这并不能保证识别真正的因果结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未测量混杂因素对观察性因果推断的限制虽已被广泛认识，但其对数据驱动因果发现的影响常被淡化。作者旨在从渐近角度严格刻画这一局限，揭示统计推断与因果机制恢复之间的根本性区别。

Method: 采用渐近理论分析框架，研究在真实因果变量不可观测、仅能获取相关代理变量的条件下，基于数据的因果发现算法随样本量增大的行为特征，通过数学推导刻画因果结构搜索的渐近性质。

Result: 当真实因果变量未观测但存在相关代理变量时，随着样本量增加并搜索越来越稳定的数据驱动因果结构，涉及可观测代理变量的关联会变得越来越确定。但这一确定性的提升并不能保证识别出底层的真实因果结构，揭示了减少统计不确定性与恢复因果机制之间的根本区别。

Conclusion: 更多的数据可以提升对观测变量空间内真实关系的确定性，但无法为识别底层因果结构提供保证。这一发现对依赖纯数据驱动方法进行因果发现的研究和实践具有重要警示意义。

Abstract: Unmeasured confounding is widely recognized as a limitation of observational causal inference, but its implications for data-driven causal discovery are often understated. We provide an asymptotic characterization of this limitation. When the true causal variable is unobserved but correlated proxy variables are available, increasing sample size while searching for increasingly stable, data-driven causal structures will make associations involving observable proxies become increasingly certain. This result highlights a fundamental distinction between reducing statistical uncertainty and recovering causal mechanisms: more data can improve certainty about genuine relationships within the observed variable space while providing no guarantee of identifying the underlying causal structure.

</details>


### [192] [Doubly Robust Estimators of Quantile Treatment Effects With Semiparametric Cumulative Probability Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27633)
*Hao Wu,Chun Li,Bryan E. Shepherd*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于累积概率模型（CPM）的双重稳健框架，用于估计分位数处理效应（QTE），无需对结果分布做参数假设。方法包括逆CDF法和直接估计法两种策略，均可推广至概率处理效应。模拟与HIV数据验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统因果推断聚焦于潜在结果均值，但HIV等生物医学研究中，结果常呈偏态分布且受检测限影响，需评估处理对整个结果分布的影响。现有QTE方法依赖分布假设，对模型误设敏感，因此需要一种更稳健的估计框架。

Method: 基于累积概率模型（CPM）——一种基于秩的半参数线性变换模型，提出双重稳健QTE估计框架。两种策略：(1)逆CDF法：先用有效影响函数（EIF）估计潜在结果的边际CDF，再通过加权分位数插值反演得到边际分位数；(2)直接法：直接求解潜在边际分位数的EIF。框架扩展至概率处理效应（PTE）及其条件版本。方差估计方面考察了EIF法、三明治估计法和非参数自助法。

Result: 所提估计量具有双重稳健性和渐近正态性。模拟研究显示，经验三明治估计和非参数自助法在讨厌参数模型误设下能提供双重稳健的方差估计，有限样本表现稳定。蒙特卡洛模拟和HIV数据应用验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 提出的CPM-based双重稳健QTE估计框架克服了传统方法对分布假设的依赖，在偏态和截尾数据场景下表现优越，为生物医学研究中处理效应分布层面的评估提供了可靠工具。

Abstract: The causal inference literature has traditionally focused on estimating the mean of the potential outcome, whereas evaluating how a treatment affects the entire outcome distribution can provide additional information in biomedical research. Quantile treatment effect (QTE) captures such distributional differences, particularly when outcomes are skewed. However, existing approaches for estimating QTE make distributional assumptions about the outcome and are thus sensitive to model misspecification. Motivated by an HIV study with skewed outcomes, one of which is subject to detection limits, we propose a doubly robust framework for estimating QTE based on the cumulative probability model (CPM), which is a rank-based, semiparametric linear transformation model. We develop two CPM-based estimation strategies: (1) an inverse-cumulative distribution function (CDF) approach that first estimates the marginal CDF of potential outcomes using the efficient influence function (EIF) and then obtains marginal quantiles via weighted quantile interpolation by inverting the distribution, and (2) a direct approach that solves the EIF of potential marginal quantiles. The proposed estimators are doubly robust and asymptotically normal. We further extend the framework to probability treatment effects (PTEs) and their conditional counterparts. For statistical inference, we investigate several variance estimation procedures, including EIF-based estimators, sandwich estimators, and the nonparametric bootstrap. Simulation studies illustrate that the empirical sandwich estimator and the nonparametric bootstrap provide doubly robust variance estimation with stable finite-sample performance under nuisance model misspecification. The proposed methods are evaluated through extensive Monte Carlo simulations and illustrated using an HIV data application.

</details>


### [193] [Mediation Analysis with Multiple Mediators Subject to Missing Not at Random](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27669)
*Yanfei Jin,Shanshan Luo,Xueli Wang,Zhi Geng*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文研究了多个中介变量存在非随机缺失（MNAR）时的因果中介分析，提出了一类广泛的MNAR机制下的识别与估计框架，推广了现有中介分析方法以处理不可忽略的缺失中介变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多个中介变量的中介分析方法通常假设完全观测或随机缺失（MAR），当缺失机制为非随机缺失（MNAR）时，估计会产生偏误。然而，实际应用中MNAR情形普遍存在，亟需方法上的拓展。

Method: 作者考虑一类广义MNAR机制——缺失可依赖于未观测的中介变量、处理、协变量和结局。在此框架下，逐步建立不同MNAR假设下自然直接效应和自然间接效应的可识别性条件，并提出相应的估计程序，通过模拟研究评估有限样本表现。
