Result: 模拟研究表明所提方法在多种缺失场景下表现令人满意。NHANES数据的实证应用展示了该方法在不可忽略缺失数据下探究中介路径的实用价值。

Conclusion: 该研究将因果中介分析推广至中介变量存在非随机缺失的情形，在逐步弱化的MNAR假设下建立了效应可识别性，为实践中处理不可忽略缺失中介变量提供了有效的方法论工具。

Abstract: Causal mediation analysis serves as a key tool for uncovering the mediating mechanisms linking treatments to outcomes. Existing methods for mediation analysis with multiple mediators typically assume complete observations or missing-at-random and may yield biased estimation when mediator values are missing not at random (MNAR). This paper studies the identification and estimation of causal mediation effects with multiple mediators subject to MNAR missingness. We consider a broad class of MNAR mechanisms in which missingness may depend on unobserved mediators, treatment, covariates, and outcomes. Under a series of increasingly general MNAR mechanisms, we establish identified natural direct and indirect effects, effectively generalizing existing mediation analysis to handle nonignorable missing mediators. Based on the proposed identification framework, we develop estimation procedures for causal mediation effects and evaluate their finite-sample performance through simulation studies. The results demonstrate satisfactory performance across a range of missingness scenarios. An application to data from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey(NHANES) illustrates the practical utility of the proposed methodology for investigating mediation pathways in the presence of nonignorable missing data.

</details>


### [194] [A Bayesian Bootstrap Method for Survival Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27678)
*K Shuvo Bakar,Armando Teixeira-Pinto*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种将贝叶斯自助法（Bayesian bootstrap）与广义贝叶斯更新（Gibbs updating）相结合的生存分析方法，通过Dirichlet权重生成生存估计量的非参数分布，并利用损失函数融入先验信息，无需完整似然函数。该方法以Cox比例风险模型为例进行了开发，模拟研究和实际数据验证了其稳健的不确定性量化能力和先验信息整合效果，并提供了开源R包BayesBoots。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生存分析中，传统贝叶斯方法需要完整概率似然，对分布假设敏感且计算量大，在存在删失、小样本和异质人群时不确定性量化困难。亟需一种模型无关、无需完整似然且能灵活融入先验信息的方法。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1) 贝叶斯自助法：通过Dirichlet权重生成生存估计量的分布，非参数化刻画抽样不确定性；(2) 广义贝叶斯（Gibbs）更新：在广义贝叶斯框架下使用损失函数融入模型参数的先验信息，得到后验分布。该方法模型无关，适用于多种生存估计量。以Cox比例风险模型为例具体开发。

Result: 模拟研究表明该方法能稳健进行不确定性量化并有效融入先验信息；右删失生存数据的实际应用验证了其实用性。配套开发了开源R包BayesBoots。

Conclusion: 所提方法为生存分析中的不确定性量化提供了一种灵活、稳健且计算可行的贝叶斯方案，避免了对完整似然的依赖，兼具非参数灵活性与先验信息整合能力，具有良好的应用前景。

Abstract: Survival analysis is widely used for analyzing time-to-event data, and often uncertainty quantification remains challenging in the presence of censoring, limited sample sizes, and heterogeneous populations. Existing Bayesian survival methods provide a framework for incorporating prior information but typically require specification of a full probabilistic likelihood, making inference sensitive to distributional assumptions and sometimes computationally demanding. We propose a Bayesian approach for survival analysis that combines the Bayesian bootstrap with generalized Bayesian (Gibbs) updating. The Bayesian bootstrap first generates a distribution over survival estimators through Dirichlet weights, providing a nonparametric characterization of sampling uncertainty. Prior information for model parameter is then incorporated using a loss function within the generalized Bayesian framework, yielding an inference for posterior distribution. The proposed methodology is model-agnostic and can be applied to a broad class of survival estimators. As an illustration, we develop the framework for the Cox proportional hazards model, producing posterior inference for regression coefficients while preserving the familiar properties and interpretation of hazard ratios. Simulation studies demonstrate that the proposed approach provides robust uncertainty quantification and effectively incorporates prior information. An application to right-censored survival data further illustrates its practical utility. An open-source R package, BayesBoots, implements the proposed methodology.

</details>


### [195] [On regression with estimated covariates and conditional effects given the propensity score](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27685)
*Jiaqi Wu,Matteo Bonvini,Edward H. Kennedy,Jennie E. Brand,Yu Xie*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文研究当回归模型中某些协变量由第一步估计得到时，如何进行非参数回归估计，并提出两种去偏方法以消除第一步估计误差的影响，最后应用于教育回报异质性的实证分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受Brand & Xie (2010)关于大学教育异质性回报研究的启发，在倾向得分等协变量需通过第一步估计得到时，传统的代入估计量（plug-in estimator）会遭受第一步估计误差的污染，亟需发展能够纠正该偏差、达到"神谕速率"（oracle rates）的估计方法。

Method: 论文在一个对第一步估计方法保持不可知（agnostic）的框架下，分析了两种去偏方法：(i) 基于影响函数的路径可微参数估计量，用于逼近目标估计量；(ii) 直接纠偏的代入估计量变体。第二步回归可采用局部平滑法或筛基法。对每种方法，作者给出了估计误差的上界，并刻画了逼近神谕速率的条件。

Result: 理论分析表明两种去偏方法均可在一定条件下逼近神谕速率，相较普通代入估计量在收敛速率上有显著提升。模拟研究验证了方法的有限样本表现。应用NLSY97数据的实证结果表明，完成大学教育对就业概率的提升在最不可能上大学的人群中最大，与文献中已有发现一致。

Conclusion: 提出的两种去偏策略能够有效处理第一步估计误差对非参数回归的影响，在理论和实证上均表现良好，证实了教育回报的异质性模式——大学教育的收益在那些最不可能接受大学教育的个体中最大。

Abstract: Motivated by the study of heterogeneous returns to education in Brand & Xie 2010, which considers how the effect of completing college on earnings varies with the (unknown) probability of completing college, we analyze the problem of estimating a nonparametric regression function when certain covariates are estimated in a first step. Plug-in estimators that treat the estimated covariates as known generally suffer from first-stage estimation error. To mitigate this issue, we analyze two debiasing approaches within a framework that is agnostic to the choice of the first-stage estimation method and relies on either local-smoothing or sieve-based methods for the second-stage regression. In particular, we consider: (i) influence function-based estimators of pathwise differentiable parameters that approximate the target estimand, and (ii) a variant of plug-in estimators that directly aims to correct their bias. For each method, we upper bound the estimation error and characterize conditions under which oracle rates can be approached, highlighting the possible gains in terms of convergence rates relative to the plug-ins. Simulation studies illustrate the finite-sample behavior of the methods. We apply our methodology to data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1997 and find evidence that completing college yields the largest reductions in unemployment for individuals least likely to do so, consistent with earlier findings in the literature (Brand & Xie 2010; Brand 2023).

</details>


### [196] [On Graph-Informed Distance Metrics for Comparing Graph Partitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27689)
*Srijato Bhattacharyya,Huiyan Sang,Bani Mallick*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 提出一种基于图拓扑结构的图感知距离度量框架，用于比较网络分区。通过将顶点分区转化为诱导边分区，构造出满足度量的图知情版信息变化距离和van Dongen距离，并在随机块模型下证明拓扑破坏程度越大距离越大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图分区比较方法大多采用图无关的指标，将顶点视为可交换的，忽略了编码社区凝聚与分离信息的底层图拓扑结构。需要一种能够尊重图结构的、原则性的分区比较框架。

Method: 提出图知情距离的一般构造方法：将顶点分区通过诱导边分区进行比较，在连续图分区空间上构造有效度量。具体开发了图知情版的信息变化（VI）、van Dongen距离及其二元割基伴生距离，并证明这些距离满足局部图感知细化准则。

Result: 在随机块模型下，证明了社区间分裂和社区内分裂两种设定中，更强的拓扑破坏几乎必然导致渐近更大的距离。所提距离满足自然局部图感知细化准则，构成有效度量。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种简单且原则性的方法，在比较图分区时能够尊重底层图结构，为网络结构化数据的分析奠定了基础。

Abstract: Comparing graph partitions is fundamental to the analysis of network-structured data, yet existing measures for comparing graph partitions typically rely on graph-agnostic indices that treat vertices as exchangeable, ignoring the underlying graph topology that encodes essential information about community cohesion and separation. We propose a general construction of graph-informed distances that compares vertex partitions through induced edge partitions and yields valid metrics on the space of contiguous graph partitions. As special cases, we develop graph-informed versions of variation of information and the van Dongen distance together with a binary cut-based companion distance, and show that these distances satisfy a natural local graph-aware refinement criterion. Under stochastic block models, we prove that stronger topological disruptions incur asymptotically larger distances almost surely in both inter-community and intra-community split settings. These results provide a simple and principled framework to compare graph partitions while respecting the underlying graph structure.

</details>


### [197] [A Mathematical Framework for Topological Causal Data Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28161)
*Hugo Gobato Souto,Ioannis Diamantis*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出拓扑因果数据分析(TCDA)框架，将观测空间、因果模型类、拓扑表示与因果查询相分离，在因果假设确定后利用拓扑方法提供形状敏感的稳定摘要，涵盖结果层面和分布层面两种分析路径，并探讨了可识别性、双重稳健估计及拓扑在因果发现中的有限作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代数据分析中许多结果（图像、点云、网络、空间场等）属于结构化对象，传统的个体处理效应差 \(Y^1-Y^0\) 可能无定义或科学上不充分。需要一套能够在此类复杂数据结构上定义和估计因果效应的框架。

Method: 提出TCDA框架，明确区分四个层次：观测空间、因果模型类、拓扑表示和因果查询。区分结果层面TCDA（对个体潜在结果做拓扑变换）与分布层面TCDA（对干预结果律做拓扑变换），并刻画两者一致的条件。在结果层面，构建Banach空间值摘要的识别与双重稳健表示；在分布层面，通过g-formula实现目标识别，导出稳定性迁移界和插件一致性。引入「目标特定拓扑可忽略性」概念，阐明在无需识别完整干预律的情况下识别协变量标准化的粗效应。

Result: 建立了TCDA的完整理论框架：给出结果层面Banach空间值摘要的识别与双重稳健表示；在分布层面给出g-formula识别、稳定性迁移界及插件一致性结果；通过目标特定拓扑可忽略性，证明协变量标准化的粗效应可在不全识别干预律时被识别；明确了拓扑在因果发现中仅能辅助诊断受限模型类，不能独立识别因果结构。

Conclusion: TCDA为结构化对象的因果推断提供了原则性框架，拓扑作为因果假设之后的形状敏感摘要工具发挥作用。框架严格界定了拓扑在因果分析中的能力边界——它不能替代因果假设来识别结构，但在已设定因果模型的前提下，能够有效提取和估计复杂数据中的因果效应。

Abstract: Many modern outcomes, including images, point clouds, networks, and spatial fields, are structured objects for which \(Y^1-Y^0\) may be undefined or scientifically inadequate. We introduce \emph{Topological Causal Data Analysis} (TCDA), a framework separating the observation space, causal-model class, topological representation, and causal query. Topology does not define interventions; it supplies stable, shape-sensitive summaries after causal assumptions have been specified. We distinguish outcome-level TCDA, which transforms individual potential outcomes, from distribution-level TCDA, which transforms interventional outcome laws, and characterize when outcome and distribution level contrasts agree. Building on recent outcome-level theory, we formulate identification and doubly robust representations for Banach-space-valued summaries. At the distribution level, we identify targets through the standard causal \(g\)-formula and derive stability-transfer bounds and plug-in consistency. We also place target-specific topological ignorability within the framework, clarifying when a covariate-standardized coarse effect can be identified without identifying the full interventional laws. Finally, we delimit the role of observational topology in causal discovery: it can assist diagnosis on restricted model classes but cannot by itself identify causal structure.

</details>


### [198] [Evaluating Algorithm-Assisted Human Decision-Making Over Repeated Algorithm Exposure: Recommendations for Effect Estimands and Experimental Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27701)
*Maggie Wang,Michael Baiocchi*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文针对算法辅助决策中人类行为会随重复接触算法而适应变化的问题，定义了一组刻画行为适应效应的估计目标（estimands），提出了一种极小化最大步进双楔形设计（minimax stepped double wedge design）来估计这些目标，并与两种传统设计进行对比，证明在自动化偏差、警报疲劳和校准依赖三种现实行为动态下，传统设计会产生有偏估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高风险决策场景（如医疗）中，评估算法辅助是否真正提升人类决策质量至关重要。然而，现有的随机实验设计与分析普遍忽视了人类决策行为在重复接触算法后会发生变化（行为适应）这一关键因素，导致对算法辅助效果的评估可能存在偏差，无法真实反映长期部署后的实际效果。

Method: 首先，作者定义了一组考虑重复暴露下行为适应的效应估计目标（effect estimands），并论证了这些估计目标对于理解算法辅助影响的必要性。其次，提出了一种极小化最大步进双楔形设计（minimax stepped double wedge design），该设计能够有效估计这些目标。最后，通过回顾历史上的算法辅助随机试验，识别出两种常见的替代设计，并在自动化偏差、警报疲劳和校准依赖三种真实世界行为动态场景下，对比了所提设计与替代设计的估计偏差表现。

Result: 所提出的极小化最大步进双楔形设计能够有效估计考虑行为适应的目标效应量。相比之下，两种传统替代设计不仅不适于估计这些目标估计量，而且在自动化偏差、警报疲劳和校准依赖三种行为适应模式下均会产生有偏估计。

Conclusion: 在评估算法辅助决策效果时，必须考虑人类行为随重复暴露而适应的动态过程。研究者应采用如步进双楔形设计等专门针对行为适应效应优化的实验设计方案，以避免传统设计导致的估计偏差，从而为算法部署决策提供更可靠的证据。

Abstract: In algorithm-assisted decision-making in high-stakes settings like healthcare, an algorithmic decision support tool provides a recommendation, but the human ultimately makes the decision. Determining whether algorithm assistance actually improves the quality of human decision-making prior to deployment is critical, and randomized experiments are one way to collect robust evidence. Historically, however, experimental designs and analyses ignore how decision-making behavior adapts with repeated algorithm exposure. In this work, we define a set of effect estimands that account for and characterize human behavior adaptation under repeated exposure and justify why these estimands are useful to target for developing a better understanding of the impact of algorithm assistance. We propose a minimax stepped double wedge design that facilitates estimating these target estimands. Finally, we compare our proposed design to two common alternative designs identified through a review of historical randomized trials of algorithm assistance. We show that these designs are less amenable to estimating the target estimands and produce biased estimates under three different forms of behavioral adaptation inspired by dynamics observed in the real world -- automation bias, alert fatigue, and calibrated reliance.

</details>


### [199] [Non-partitioned e-detectors for nonparametric sequential change detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28322)
*Aytijhya Saha,Aaditya Ramdas*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文研究在未知且属于同一分布类的前后变化分布下的序贯变化检测问题，提出基于点零e-过程聚合与候选无变化分布取下确界的通用检测器类，实现ARL/PFA控制与一阶渐近最优检测延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统序贯变化检测通常需要已知或部分已知前后变化分布，且假定分布类可预先划分为变化前/后子类。本文旨在消除这些限制，处理前后分布均未知且来自同一大类、无先验划分的更现实场景。

Method: 提出一类通用序贯变化检测器：对可能的变化点聚合点零e-过程，并对候选无变化分布取下确界。聚合方案中的权重决定检测器实现的是ARL控制还是PFA控制。在适当假设下证明其一阶渐近最优性。具体示例涵盖亚高斯/有界均值变化、未知方差的高斯均值变化及马尔可夫转移矩阵变化。

Result: 所提方法在适当假设下实现一阶渐近最优检测延迟，同时可根据权重选择实现平均运行长度(ARL)控制或虚警概率(PFA)控制。具体示例验证了方法的广泛适用性。

Conclusion: 通过聚合点零e-过程与下确界操作，可在无需预划分分布类且前后分布均未知的条件下，构建兼具误报控制与渐近最优延迟的序贯变化检测器，具有广泛的适用场景。

Abstract: We study the problem of sequential change detection over a general class of probability distributions ($\mathcal P$), where both the pre-change and post-change distributions are unknown and belong to $\mathcal P$. We do not assume a pre-specified partition of $\mathcal P$ into pre- and post-change families. We propose a general class of sequential change detectors obtained by aggregating point-null e-processes over possible changepoints and taking an infimum over candidate no-change distributions. The weights in the aggregation scheme determine whether they attain average run length (ARL) control and probability-of-false-alarm (PFA) control. Under suitable assumptions, we prove that our methods achieve first-order asymptotically optimal detection delay. Concrete examples include sub-Gaussian and bounded mean changes, Gaussian mean changes with unknown variance, as well as changes in Markov transition matrices.

</details>


### [200] [Bias Correction of Long-memory Estimator of Functional Time Series via the Prefiltered Sieve Bootstrap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28177)
*Chang Liu,Han Lin Shang*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文研究了一种基于筛分自助法的偏差校正程序，用于估计平稳或非平稳分数阶积分过程中的长记忆参数 d。该方法通过对经初步长记忆参数估计预滤波后的数据实施筛分自助法，推荐使用局部多项式 Whittle 含噪估计量（LPWN）作为初始估计以减少偏差，尤其在强短程自回归依赖情形下。模拟研究表明，筛分自助增强能显著改善 LPWN 估计量的偏差，并可同时提供记忆参数的置信区间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在估计分数阶积分过程的长记忆参数 d 时，常用的局部 Whittle 估计量或去趋势波动分析估计量在存在强短程自回归依赖时会产生显著偏差。为解决这一偏差问题，需要一种有效的偏差校正方法，既能提高估计精度，又能提供不确定性量化。

Method: 本文提出一种基于筛分自助法的偏差校正程序：首先使用 Frederiksen et al. (2012) 提出的局部多项式 Whittle 含噪（LPWN）估计量对数据进行初步长记忆参数估计并进行预滤波；随后在预滤波后的数据上实施筛分自助法（sieve bootstrap），通过重采样实现偏差校正，并同时获得记忆参数的置信区间。

Result: 模拟研究表明：（1）局部 Whittle 估计量和去趋势波动分析估计量在强短程自回归依赖下存在明显偏差；（2）LPWN 估计量自身已能减少偏差；（3）通过筛分自助增强后，LPWN 估计量的偏差得到进一步改善，并能有效提供置信区间。

Conclusion: 基于筛分自助法的偏差校正程序能有效改善长记忆参数 d 的估计精度，LPWN 估计量作为初始估计并辅以筛分自助增强，在处理含强短程自回归依赖的分数阶积分过程时表现优越，且具备提供置信区间的附加价值。

Abstract: We investigate a bias correction procedure based on sieve bootstrapping to estimate the long-memory parameter d in stationary or nonstationary fractionally integrated processes. The resampling method implements a sieve bootstrap method on data prefiltered by a preliminary estimate of the long-memory parameter. For the initial estimate, we recommend the local polynomial Whittle with noise (LPWN) estimator in Frederiksen et al. (2012) to reduce bias, especially in the presence of a strong short-range autoregressive dependence. Through a series of simulation studies, we first highlight the issue of bias, using the local Whittle or detrended fluctuation analysis estimator. Then, we consider the LPWN estimator and show the potential improvement in bias achieved by its sieve bootstrap enhancement. As a byproduct, the sieve bootstrap can also provide confidence intervals of the memory parameter.

</details>


### [201] [An Interval-Score ROC Curve for Assessment, Calibration and Ensembling of Probabilistic Forecasts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28178)
*Simone Milanesi,Marco Capelletti,Flavio Bobba,Giuseppe De Nicolao*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出IS-ROC曲线框架，将概率预测评估从单一标量扩展到完整的多目标Pareto前沿，揭示预测集中度与准确性之间的权衡，并基于几何性质设计了校准与集成策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有恰当评分规则将预测性能压缩为单一标量，掩盖了预测集中度与准确性之间的多目标权衡，缺乏一个能完整刻画区间预测族及其最优前沿的几何框架。

Method: 提出区间得分接收者操作特征(IS-ROC)曲线，将不同预测紧度下的区间预测族映射为二维图形；证明数据生成过程诱导的IS-ROC曲线具有Pareto最优性和凸性；基于此设计切线优化与凸化的几何校准流程，以及通过凸包构造实现多预测器集成的策略。

Result: IS-ROC曲线为最优预测前沿提供了几何刻画；所提出的校准与集成方法可在该框架下有效实现预测比较、校准与集成。

Conclusion: IS-ROC曲线为概率预测评估提供了统一的多目标几何框架，弥补了传统标量评分规则的不足，为预测校准与集成提供了新工具。

Abstract: Probabilistic forecast evaluation is inherently multi-objective, yet existing proper scoring rules reduce predictive performance to a single scalar value, potentially obscuring the trade-off between forecast concentration and predictive accuracy. We introduce the Interval-Score Receiver Operating Characteristic (IS-ROC) Curve, a graphical framework that represents the complete family of interval forecasts generated by varying prediction tightness. We show that the IS-ROC Curve induced by the data generating process is Pareto optimal and convex, providing a geometric characterization of the optimal forecasting frontier. Building on these properties, we propose a geometry-based calibration procedure based on tangent optimization and convexification, together with an ensemble strategy that combines competing forecasters through convex hull construction. Finally, we provide a practical workflow and numerical examples illustrating forecast comparison, calibration, and ensemble construction within the proposed framework.

</details>


### [202] [Improving Discrepancy Measures for Global Sensitivity Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28252)
*Samuele Lo Piano,Alessio Lachi,Razi Sheikholeslami,Arnald Puy,Pamphile Tupui Roy,Andrea Saltelli*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出一种改进的ersatz差异度量，通过输出秩变换和Moore邻域插值空单元，使其与Sobol'总阶指数高度一致。作者从copula理论角度证明了该方法是一致性筛选统计量，并在多个基准函数和水文模型上与PCE、Shapley效应、PAWN型指标进行了对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于Sobol'总阶指数的敏感性分析方法虽然理论基础扎实，但计算成本极高。现有的ersatz差异度量虽计算廉价，但缺乏理论依据且未与其他数据驱动估计量进行基准测试。本文旨在填补这一空白，提出既有理论支撑又与总阶指数高度一致的廉价替代方案。

Method: 作者提出三项核心改进：(1) 对输出进行秩变换后再网格化；(2) 利用Moore邻域规则插补孤立空单元；(3) 通过copula理论证明调整后的指标是一致性筛选统计量，具有零条件、显式全支撑上限以及纯交互介导依赖的失效模式。基准测试中，将调整后的ersatz与多项式混沌展开(PCE)、PCE衍生的Shapley效应以及PAWN型最大KS指数在七个基准函数和一个真实水文模型上进行比较，并对五个算法超参数进行联合敏感性分析。

Result: 调整后的ersatz是唯一在非光滑水文输出（PCE在该场景下存在模型误设）上实现完美秩一致的估计量。网格分辨率而非插补阈值或采样方法是驱动性能变异的主要因素。

Conclusion: 调整后的ersatz差异度量是一种理论上经过验证、计算高效且与Sobol'总阶指数高度一致的敏感性筛选工具，特别适用于复杂模型（如PCE误设的非光滑输出场景），为高计算成本下的全局敏感性分析提供了可靠替代方案。

Abstract: Sensitivity analysis methods based on Sobol' total-order indices ($T_i$) are well-founded but computationally demanding. A recently proposed ersatz discrepancy measure offers a cheaper alternative by quantifying deviations from uniformity in input--output scatterplots, yet lacks theoretical grounding and has not been benchmarked against other data-given estimators. We introduce an adjusted ersatz discrepancy that rank-transforms the output before gridding and imputes isolated empty cells via a Moore-neighbourhood rule, substantially improving agreement with $T_i$. We prove, via a copula-theoretic argument, that the adjustment is a consistent screening statistic with a zero condition, an explicit full-support ceiling bounding its use as a magnitude estimator, and a documented failure mode for purely interaction-mediated dependencies. We benchmark the adjusted ersatz against three zero-extra-cost comparators -- polynomial chaos expansion (PCE), PCE-derived Shapley effects, and a PAWN-type maximum Kolmogorov--Smirnov index -- across seven benchmark functions and a real-world hydrological model. The adjusted ersatz is the only estimator achieving perfect rank agreement on a non-smooth hydrological output where PCE is misspecified. A joint sensitivity analysis of five algorithmic parameters shows grid resolution, not the imputation threshold or sampling method, drives performance variability.

</details>


### [203] [A Novel Approach to Instrumental Variable Estimation: TEAM-IV](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28289)
*Steven Y. Alberding,Patrick J. Breheny*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: TEAM-IV是一种新的工具变量方法，通过识别联合有效的工具变量子集（"团队"）并进行聚合，即使在仅有少数（少至两个）候选工具变量有效的情况下也能实现可靠估计，在模拟和实证研究中均优于现有方法sisVIVE和CIIV。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稳健IV方法（如sisVIVE和CIIV）依赖多数有效性或多数性有效性条件，当无效工具变量普遍存在时表现不佳。需要一种即使仅有两个有效工具变量也能可靠估计的方法。

Method: TEAM-IV在重叠的工具变量子集上拟合结果变量对投影暴露的MCP惩罚模型；将直接效应经常被一起压缩为零的工具变量识别为候选"团队"；按样本外预测性能对团队排序，取近最优团队的并集作为最终IV集合进行估计。

Result: 模拟中，TEAM-IV在不同无效直接效应的数量、大小、符号、工具变量相关性及暴露内生性条件下，估计误差绝对值普遍低于sisVIVE和CIIV，在无效工具变量普遍时优势最大。MESA实证应用和两项验证研究进一步证明了其优势。

Conclusion: TEAM-IV通过联合有效性框架突破了多数/多数性条件的限制，为工具变量分析中排除限制被违反的情境提供了一种更稳健的解决方案。

Abstract: Instrumental-variable (IV) analyses can be undermined when some instruments violate the exclusion restriction through direct effects on the outcome. Existing robust IV methods, including sisVIVE and CIIV, rely on majority- or plurality-validity conditions. We propose TEAM-IV, which targets joint validity by identifying sets of instruments that appear valid together and aggregating them, allowing reliable estimation even when only a small number of candidate instruments are valid (potentially as few as two). TEAM-IV fits MCP-penalized models of the outcome on projected exposure over overlapping instrument subsets. Instruments whose estimated direct effects are frequently shrunk to zero together (suggesting concordant validity status) form candidate ``teams'' (instrument sets). Teams are ranked by their out-of-sample predictive performance; near-best teams are unioned and used as the instrument set for the IV estimate. Across simulations varying the number, magnitude, and signs of invalid direct effects, instrument correlation, and exposure endogeneity, TEAM-IV generally attains lower absolute estimation error than sisVIVE and CIIV. Relative gains are largest when invalid instruments are prevalent. TEAM-IV is demonstrated in an empirical Mendelian randomization application using the Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis (MESA) concerning the effect of LDL cholesterol on carotid intima--media thickness. Two additional MESA-anchored validation studies demonstrate differences between TEAM-IV and sisVIVE under challenging invalid-instrument configurations.

</details>


### [204] [A Riemannian Factor Model for Manifold-Valued Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28385)
*Shuo-Chieh Huang,Rong Chen,Yaqing Chen*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 提出一种用于分析黎曼流形上高维时间序列的黎曼因子模型（RFM），该模型具有几何感知能力，在高维渐近框架下获得了与线性因子模型匹配的维度无关收敛速率，并在Bures-Wasserstein流形及球面乘积流形上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经济学、金融、医学影像、基因组学等领域中，时间序列数据常具有非线性流形结构，传统线性因子模型无法捕捉这种几何特性，因此需要一种能够处理流形约束下高维时间序列的因子建模框架。

Method: 提出黎曼因子模型（RFM），在流形维数可随样本量n发散的渐近框架下进行分析，假设短记忆和强因子条件，推导载荷空间估计的收敛速率。

Result: 在短记忆和强因子条件下，获得了维度无关的n^{-1/2}收敛速率，与高维线性因子模型的速率相匹配。在Bures-Wasserstein流形和球面乘积流形上的模拟以及美股已实现协方差矩阵的实证应用中，RFM展现出可解释的因子和竞争力的预测性能。

Conclusion: RFM成功将因子模型推广到黎曼流形设定，在保持与线性情形相同收敛速率的同时，能够捕捉数据的非线性几何结构，具有良好的理论和实证表现。

Abstract: We propose a Riemannian factor model (RFM), a novel framework for analyzing potentially high-dimensional time series data observed on Riemannian manifolds. Such time series are encountered in various applications, including economics, finance, medical imaging, and genomics and microbiome research. The proposed model is geometry-aware and accounts for the inherent nonlinearity in the data. In a high-dimensional asymptotic regime, where the manifold dimension is allowed to diverge with the sample size $n$, we establish convergence rates for the estimated loading space. In particular, under short-memory and strong factor conditions, we obtain a dimension-free $n^{-1/2}$ rate, which matches the convergence rate of the high-dimensional linear factor model. Finite-sample performance of the proposed RFM is demonstrated with simulated time series on the Bures--Wasserstein manifolds and products of spheres, as well as an application to monthly realized covariances of selected U.S. stock returns---modeled as time series in the Bures--Wasserstein manifold, where the RFM provides demonstrably interpretable factors and yields competitive predictive performance.

</details>


### [205] [Capture history analysis for spatial wildlife surveys with detection times](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28455)
*Benjamin R. Baer,David L. Borchers,Greg Distiller*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文基于事件史分析中的计数过程理论，提出了一种统一的极大似然估计框架，用于处理已知捕获时间时、采用近程探测器、多捕获陷阱、单捕获陷阱及移除类陷阱的个体可识别动物调查数据，解决了单捕获陷阱和移除调查中的开放问题，并引入了多捕获陷阱的新统计方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多野生动物调查依赖个体动物的捕获历史，但现有方法很少同时利用捕获时间和捕获位置信息。尤其在单捕获陷阱和移除调查中存在方法上的开放问题，多捕获陷阱也缺乏合适的统计方法，亟需一个统一的分析框架。

Method: 利用事件史（生存）分析中的计数过程理论，构建极大似然估计器。该框架统一适用于近程探测器、多捕获陷阱、单捕获陷阱和移除陷阱四种调查场景，并能同时纳入捕获时间和位置信息。

Result: 通过模拟测试验证了新方法的有效性，并将方法应用于新西兰负鼠的单捕获陷阱实际数据进行分析。

Conclusion: 以计数过程理论为基础的极大似然估计框架，为利用捕获时间和位置的个体可识别动物调查提供了一种统一、灵活的统计方法，填补了单捕获陷阱、移除调查及多捕获陷阱在方法学上的空白。

Abstract: Many wildlife surveys of species with individually identifiable animals are based on the analysis of the capture histories of individual animals. However, not many of these take account of both the animals' capture times and their capture locations. In this work, we develop a maximum likelihood estimator for surveys of individually identifiable animals using proximity detectors, multi-catch traps, single-catch traps, and traps that remove animals from the population, when capture times are known. We do this using the counting process theory at the foundation of event history (or survival) analysis. The work provides a unifying framework for such surveys, resolves open problems for single-catch traps and removal surveys, and introduces a new statistical method for multi-catch traps. We test the new methods by simulation and we present an analysis of possums in New Zealand caught with single-catch traps.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [206] [Recursive transformers for semiconductor thermo-mechanical reliability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27251)
*Kart-leong Lim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文评估了三种递归权重共享Transformer架构在工程代理建模中的应用，提出了一种Depth Recursive Transformer，系统比较了预测性能、参数量和计算复杂度，验证了递归Transformer在小数据、低维工程场景下实现精度-效率权衡的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Transformer代理模型在工程设计中存在过参数化问题：工程数据集通常规模小、维度低，但仿真数据生成成本高昂。在此条件下，过多的可学习参数导致过拟合而非精度提升，同时带来不必要的内存和计算开销。这促使研究从增加可学习参数转向增加计算量（即递归计算）的架构设计方向。

Method: 提出并比较三种递归Transformer范式：a) Tiny递归模型，b) 作者提出的Depth Recursive Transformer，c) 简单递归Transformer。系统评估指标包括：预测性能（Recall、Mean Reciprocal Rank）、参数量、计算复杂度（FLOPs）。在两个低维工程预测任务上进行验证：1）先进半导体封装的 thermo-mechanical 可靠性分析（有限元分析下的应力与翘曲预测）；2）Laplace PDE迭代数值求解器（电容场）。

Result: 递归权重共享Transformer在小数据工程代理建模中，实现了预测精度、参数效率与计算成本之间的有效且可泛化的权衡。Depth Recursive Transformer在保持竞争力的预测性能同时，显著降低了参数量。

Conclusion: 对于资源受限的小数据工程代理建模场景，递归权重共享Transformer提供了一种优于传统过参数化Transformer的设计范式，强调通过递归计算而非增加参数来提升模型能力，为工程实践提供了选择递归Transformer架构的实用设计指南。

Abstract: Transformer-based surrogate models are increasingly used to replace expensive first-principles simulation in engineering design. But conventional transformer architectures are often over parameterized for the small, low-dimensional datasets typical of engineering design spaces, where large simulation data is expensive to generate. Under these conditions, excess parameter capacity leads to overfitting rather than improved accuracy, while also incurring unnecessary memory and compute overhead. This motivates a shift towards architectures that focus on additional compute rather than additional learnable parameters. This paper presents a hardware-aware evaluation of three recursive transformer paradigms for surrogate thermo-mechanical analysis of advanced packages: a)Tiny Recursive Model, b) our proposed Depth Recursive transformer, c) and a simple recursive transformer. We systematically compare their predictive performance (Recall, Mean Reciprocal Rank), parameter count, computational complexity (FLOPs), providing practical design guidelines for selecting recursive transformer architectures under resource-constrained scenarios. We validate this principle on two low-dimensional engineering prediction tasks: 1) thermo-mechanical reliability analysis of advanced semiconductor packages, where stress and warpage from thermal cycling must be evaluated repeatedly across a design-of-experiments sweep under costly finite element analysis (FEA). 2) Laplace PDE iterative numerical solver for capacitance field. Overall, recursive weight-sharing transformers provide an effective and generalizable trade-off between prediction accuracy, parameter efficiency, and computational cost for small data engineering surrogate modeling.

</details>


### [207] [Regularizing modality contribution drift in multimodal continual learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27260)
*Zhen Zhang,Jielei Chu,Bin Liu,Tianrui Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出模态贡献漂移（MCD）概念，指多模态持续学习中各模态相对贡献随任务增量的决策级偏移，并设计了CMCDR方法——通过模态子集干预测量贡献剖面，以回放或无回放的方式正则化旧任务的模态贡献结构，有效缓解遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态持续学习方法侧重跨模态对齐或语义相似度，忽略了一个关键问题：各模态及其交互对决策的相对贡献在增量任务中是否保持稳定。作者将此定义为模态贡献漂移（MCD），并指出现有方法无法可靠缓解这种漂移。

Method: 首先，提出MCD分数，通过对模态子集施加受控干预，综合衡量贡献强度变化和相对依赖变化。其次，提出CMCDR方法：回放版本以存储的旧样本为探针，用模态子集干预提取贡献剖面，约束当前模型与冻结旧模型之间的模态特定贡献和交互贡献差异；无回放版本以当前任务样本为探针，蒸馏冻结模型的旧任务贡献响应，无需存储旧样本即可正则化贡献剖面。

Result: 在多模态类增量学习和持续视觉问答两个任务上验证了CMCDR的通用性和有效性，表现出优于现有方法的性能。

Conclusion: 模态贡献漂移是多模态持续学习中被忽视的核心问题。CMCDR通过正则化旧任务的模态贡献结构，在回放和无回放两种场景下均能有效缓解灾难性遗忘，为MMCL提供了新的解决思路。

Abstract: Multimodal continual learning (MMCL) aims to learn emerging knowledge from multimodal data while preserving knowledge. To mitigate forgetting, current MMCL methods usually focus on cross-modal representation alignment or semantic similarity, but they overlook whether the relative contributions of individual modalities and their interactions remain stable across incremental tasks. We term this decision-level shift Modality Contribution Drift (MCD) and quantify it with the MCD score, which combines contribution-strength and relative-reliance changes under controlled interventions on modality subsets. Theoretical and empirical analyses further explain why current MMCL methods cannot reliably mitigate this drift. To this end, we propose Continual Modality Contribution Drift Regularization (CMCDR), which preserves the modality contribution structure of previously learned tasks. Since MMCL settings differ in whether old exemplars are available, CMCDR includes both replay-based and replay-free versions. The replay-based version uses modality-subset interventions as diagnostic probes on stored old samples, compares their contribution profiles between the current model and a frozen previous model, and constrains changes in old-sample modality-specific and interaction contributions. The replay-free version uses current-task samples as probes and distills the frozen model's old-task contribution responses, thereby regularizing the observed contribution profile without exemplars. Experiments on multimodal class-incremental learning and continual visual question answering validate the generality and effectiveness of CMCDR.

</details>


### [208] [DoTime: A Synthetic Benchmark Generator for Interventional and Counterfactual Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27263)
*Dennis Thumm,Billy Tim Anthony,Ying Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DoTime 是一个开源、可扩展的多元时序结构因果模型（TSCM）生成器，支持连续时间干预窗口、反事实采样、机制切换 SCM 等新能力，并提供基准套件。实验表明，基于干预先验的 PFN 在方向准确性上始终优于同等容量的观测模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列因果推断基准多为观测性、小规模或领域特定，在医疗、政策评估和气候科学等关键应用场景中，干预和反事实估计缺乏充分支持。

Method: 提出 DoTime 生成器，构建带干预的多元时序 SCM，引入连续时间干预窗口、共享噪声反事实采样（含 positivity guard）、机制切换 SCM（推广中断时间序列）、非平稳动力学（切换 SCM 参数）以及确定性斜坡/正弦干预剖面。发布 PyPI 包 dotime 及四个冻结评估套件，含 10 万条轨迹和 8 种命名识别结构。以 PFN 为因果基础模型参考实现，比较干预训练与观测训练的方向准确性。

Result: 在所有测试的结构、轨迹长度和随机种子下，干预先验拟合网络（PFN）在保留回合上的方向准确度优势均为正值，一致优于同等容量的观测模型。

Conclusion: DoTime 填补了时间序列因果推断中干预与反事实基准的空白，其生成的干预先验能可测量地提升因果方向预测，验证了"干预训练优于纯观测训练"的可证伪主张。

Abstract: Most benchmarks for causal inference over time series are observational, small, or domain-specific, leaving interventional and counterfactual estimation under-served exactly where it matters most, such as in healthcare, policy evaluation, and climate science. We introduce \textbf{DoTime}, an open, scalable, and theoretically grounded generator of multivariate temporal structural causal models (TSCMs) with interventions, released as the \code{dotime} PyPI package together with four frozen evaluation suites. Beyond existing work, it adds capabilities absent from prior generators: continuous-time intervention \emph{windows}, counterfactual sampling modes with a positivity guard, regime-switching SCMs as a strict generalization of interrupted time series, non-stationary dynamics by construction with switching SCM parameters, and deterministic ramp and sinusoidal intervention profiles that place trends and structural breaks \emph{inside} the evaluation window. Moreover, it demonstrates the suitability of the generator as a prior for a causal foundation model reference implementation. The released suites span a training-scale snapshot of $100{,}000$ trajectories and eight named identification structures, each with exact ground truth: paired interventional trajectories from the same SCM throughout, and shared-noise counterfactuals in the continuous-time suite. We ship reference baseline implementations with an evaluation harness, and pose a falsifiable claim: interventional training buys a measurable direction-accuracy advantage over an observational model of identical capacity. It is tested across three training seeds per arm. Under structure-matched evaluation on held-out episodes, the interventional prior-fitted network's (PFN) gap is positive in every structure, trajectory length, and seed tested.

</details>


### [209] [PlatformBid: An Auto-Bidding Benchmark from a Unified Advertising Platform's Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27265)
*Shengtian Yang,Yewen Li,Peng Jiang,Zhiyi Lyu,Bo An,Peng Jiang,Qingpeng Cai,Lei Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 PlatformBid，首个从统一广告平台视角设计的自动出价基准，涵盖同质竞争、异质竞争和促销竞争三种场景，系统评估现有方法并提出基于流匹配的新方法 BidFlow，在快手线上实验中获得+0.68%的目标成本改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动出价算法仅关注 DSP 侧广告主转化最大化，但当前大型广告平台（如社交媒体、电商）已将 SSP、DSP 和 Ad Exchange 内部整合，平台视角需同时最大化广告主转化和平台总收入。缺乏统一平台视角的评估框架，亟需推进相关研究。

Method: (1) 设计 PlatformBid 基准，定义三种典型出价场景：同质竞争（相同算法）、异质竞争（不同算法策略）、促销竞争（预算激增）。 (2) 系统评估经典控制方法、RL 方法、生成式方法。 (3) 提出 BidFlow，一种基于流匹配（flow-matching）的新型自动出价方法，利用流匹配的表达性策略表征有效处理动态竞争环境。

Result: 在三种场景下系统评估了各类现有方法；BidFlow 在快手线上实验中实现目标成本（target cost）改善 +0.68%，验证了 PlatformBid 的离线-在线一致性。

Conclusion: PlatformBid 填补了统一平台视角自动出价基准的空白，BidFlow 通过流匹配方法在动态竞争环境中表现优异，且离线评估与在线部署效果一致，为广告平台自动出价研究提供了新的评估范式与有效方法。

Abstract: Real-time bidding is central to computational advertising, comprising three elements: Supply Side Platform (SSP) selling ad impressions, Demand Side Platform (DSP) bidding for advertisers, and Ad Exchange conducting auctions between them. Traditional auto-bidding algorithms focus solely on the DSP side, maximizing advertiser conversions by adjusting bids against competitors. However, current big ad platforms, such as social media and e-commerce companies, now integrate SSP, DSP, and Ad Exchange functions internally. From such ad platforms' perspective, the goal of the auto-bidding algorithms is not only to maximize the advertisers' conversions, but also the total revenue of the platform. Given the lack of platform-centric evaluation frameworks and the pressing need to advance auto-bidding research, we propose PlatformBid - the first comprehensive benchmark designed from a unified ad platform's perspective. To accurately reflect the real-world auto-bidding scenarios, we define three representative settings: (1) homogeneous competition with identical algorithms across advertisers, (2) heterogeneous competition with diverse algorithmic strategies, and (3) promotional competition where some advertisers surge budgets for boosting sales during promotional events like Black Friday. We systematically evaluate a broad spectrum of existing auto-bidding methods across these settings, encompassing classical control methods, RL-based methods, and recent generative methods. Besides these methods, we further propose a novel auto-bidding method based on flow-matching, termed BidFlow, which leverages the flow-matching method's expressive policy representation to effectively handle dynamic competitive environments. Online experiments on Kuaishou further show a +0.68\% improvement in target cost, providing deployment evidence for the offline-online consistency of PlatformBid.

</details>


### [210] [Beyond KV Reconstruction: Functional Reconstruction for MLA Draft Models in Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27269)
*Weiye Shi,Fanxu Meng,Muhan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对MHA/GQA模型转换为MLA时出现的注意力函数误差导致推测解码接受率下降的问题，提出了一种"功能重建"方法——以原始模型的输出投影后响应为优化目标，对转换后的MLA注意力模块进行端到端校准，从而在保持缓存压缩优势的同时恢复推测解码的草案接受率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLA通过紧凑潜在状态替代KV缓存来降低长上下文推理的内存开销，但现有高质量开源模型多采用MHA/GQA，需通过转换获得MLA效率。然而直接转换引入的低秩分解和RoPE处理误差虽对独立生成影响不大，却会显著降低推测解码中草案token的接受率，削弱加速效果。因此需要一种能保持注意力函数保真度的转换方法。

Method: 提出端到端功能重建方法（Functional Reconstruction）：将MLA转换问题从"缓存压缩"重新定义为"功能重建"，以原始MHA/GQA注意力模块的输出投影后响应作为监督信号，在校准隐状态上优化每个转换后的MLA注意力模块，使其精确复现原始模块的输出。该方法与具体转换器无关，不改变已转换的缓存和推理图结构，也无需验证器logits或监督。

Result: 在4组Llama/Qwen草案-目标模型对、TransMLA和MHA2MLA两种转换器、HF和vLLM两种后端、4个200-prompt任务的共计192组配置上评估。以0.5个百分点为报告容忍度，功能重建在64个匹配任务单元中的37个上显著提升接受率，26个基本不变，仅1个显著下降。

Conclusion: 将MLA草案构建重新定义为功能重建而非缓存压缩，能有效恢复MHA/GQA-to-MLA转换在推测解码中的草案接受率，为无需重训即可同时获得MLA缓存效率和推测解码加速提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Multi-head latent attention (MLA) is increasingly important for long-context LLM inference because compact latent states replace the growing key-value (KV) cache and reduce decoding memory traffic. Yet most capable open checkpoints use multi-head or grouped-query attention (MHA/GQA), so conversion is needed to obtain MLA's cache efficiency without retraining from scratch. Speculative decoding offers complementary acceleration, but its speedup depends on agreement between draft proposals and target verification. We find that direct MHA/GQA-to-MLA conversion can sharply reduce this agreement: low-rank factorization and RoPE handling introduce attention-function errors that may be tolerable for standalone generation but substantially lower draft-token acceptance. We therefore formulate MLA draft construction as functional reconstruction rather than cache compression. Our end-to-end (E2E) method optimizes each converted MLA attention module to reproduce the post-output-projection response of its original MHA/GQA counterpart on calibration hidden states. This converter-agnostic post-conversion procedure preserves the converted cache and inference graph and requires neither verifier logits nor verifier supervision. We evaluate 192 model-converter-backend-method-task configurations spanning four Llama/Qwen draft-target pairs, TransMLA and MHA2MLA, HF and vLLM, and four 200-prompt tasks. With a 0.5-percentage-point reporting tolerance, Functional Reconstruction materially improves acceptance in 37 of 64 matched task cells, leaves 26 practically unchanged, and materially decreases one. Code and evaluation artifacts are available at https://github.com/swyhahaha/FunctionalMLA.

</details>


### [211] [RLPF: Reinforcement Learning from Performance Feedback for Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27271)
*Huihao Jing,Haozhe Cui,Wenbin Hu,Shaojin Chen,Haochen Shi,Changxuan Fan,Yuxuan Liu,Hanyu Yang,Sirui Zhang,Ziyi Chen,Haoran Li,Yangqiu Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RLPF（基于性能反馈的强化学习），通过将执行结果转化为分阶段奖励来训练代码智能体偏好更快的正确实现：失败程序按执行进度排序，正确程序按相对效率改进排名。在PerfCodeBench上微调Qwen3-32B后，正确可运行率从11.1%提升至54.6%，相对效率从8.1%提升至38.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前代码模型的训练信号大多止步于正确性，忽略了系统代码中同等重要的运行效率。运行时间作为奖励信号非常脆弱：仅在程序正确后才有意义、跨任务不可比、且大多数采样程序无法编译或运行时信息量极低。

Method: 提出RLPF（Reinforcement Learning from Performance Feedback），设计了两阶段复合奖励函数：(1) 对失败程序，按执行进度（编译通过→运行通过→部分测试通过）排序；(2) 对正确程序，按相对效率改进排名，度量其从基线到专家参考解的逼近程度。基于此奖励在PerfCodeBench上对Qwen3-32B进行强化学习微调。

Result: 在PerfCodeBench上，正确且可运行的解决方案从11.1%提升至54.6%，相对效率从8.1%提升至38.6%。训练后的模型可与更强的开源系统竞争，其优化行为可适度迁移至EffiBench-X。消融实验表明模型生成的参考解提供有用但较弱的监督，完整复合奖励比仅正确性或仅运行时的基线更可靠。

Conclusion: 代码智能体不仅可以被训练为通过测试，还可以被训练为优化其编写程序的性能效率。RLPF为将效率纳入代码模型训练目标提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Code models are increasingly trained with execution feedback, but most training signals still stop at correctness. This leaves an important gap for systems code: two programs can pass the same tests while differing greatly in runtime. We study how to train code agents to prefer faster correct implementations, rather than treating efficiency only as an evaluation metric. The key difficulty is that runtime is a fragile reward. It is meaningful only after a program is correct, varies across tasks, and gives little guidance when most sampled programs fail to compile or run. We propose \textbf{RLPF}, reinforcement learning from performance feedback, which turns execution outcomes into a staged reward. Failed programs are ordered by execution progress, while correct programs are ranked by their relative improvement from the baseline toward the expert reference. This gives useful feedback before correctness and performance-sensitive feedback after correctness. Fine-tuning Qwen3-32B with RLPF on PerfCodeBench raises correct-and-runnable solutions from $11.1\%$ to $54.6\%$ and improves relative efficiency from $8.1\%$ to $38.6\%$. The trained model becomes competitive with stronger open-weight systems, and its optimization behavior transfers modestly to EffiBench-X. Additional studies show that model-generated references provide useful but weaker supervision, and that the full composite reward is more reliable than correctness-only or runtime-only baselines. These results suggest that code agents can be trained not only to pass tests, but also to optimize the programs they write.

</details>


### [212] [SDO: Structure-Aware Data Organization for Efficient LLM Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27273)
*Jinliang Gao,Ning Yang,Hai Wang,Baili Xiao,Pin Lyu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SDO（Structure-Aware Data Organization），一种面向大语言模型后训练的即插即用数据组织框架，通过基于表征空间结构的暴露驱动反馈机制，动态调整mini-batch组成和样本曝光频率，在SFT、DPO和GRPO场景下均能加速收敛，尤其在训练早中期阶段效果显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型后训练的效率优化主要聚焦于选择信息量丰富的样本或设计训练调度策略，而数据组织本身通常被视为静态预处理步骤。基于嵌入的分组方法在训练前构建固定分区，无法适应优化过程中不断变化的样本曝光需求，导致所有样本获得相似的曝光度，造成部分样本冗余更新而另一些样本欠优化。

Method: 提出SDO框架：(1) 基于冻结的外部嵌入，逐epoch运行，避免模型预热训练开销；(2) epoch内，通过KNN邻域遍历实现局部感知批处理（locality-aware batching），形成连贯的mini-batch；(3) epoch间，采用曝光均衡调度（exposure-balanced scheduling），记录每个样本的参与次数，降低过曝光样本的采样概率，保持长期覆盖。

Result: SDO在SFT、DPO和GRPO三种后训练范式下均加速了收敛，尤其在训练早中期阶段收益最大；同时产生更连贯的梯度，并在不同问题类型上实现更均衡的准确率，且不会永久排除任何训练样本。

Conclusion: SDO作为一种即插即用的数据组织框架，通过将数据组织从静态预处理转变为暴露驱动的动态自适应过程，有效解决了大语言模型后训练中样本曝光不均衡的问题，在保持全覆盖的同时显著提升训练效率。

Abstract: Post-training of large language models is expensive, and existing efficiency improvements mainly focus on selecting informative samples or designing training schedules. However, data organization itself is usually treated as a static preprocessing step: embedding-based grouping methods construct fixed partitions before training and cannot adapt to the evolving sample exposure during optimization. As a result, all samples receive similar exposure despite their different optimization needs, leading to redundant updates for some samples while leaving others under-optimized. To address this problem, we propose SDO (Structure-Aware Data Organization), a plug-and-play data organization framework with an exposure-driven feedback mechanism that organizes mini-batch composition and sample exposure according to representation-space structure. SDO operates epoch by epoch on frozen external embeddings, avoiding model warm-up training overhead: within each epoch, locality-aware batching forms coherent mini-batches via KNN neighborhood traversal; across epochs, exposure-balanced scheduling records per-sample participation and reduces the sampling probability of over-exposed samples to preserve long-term coverage. Across SFT, DPO, and GRPO, SDO accelerates convergence, with the largest gains observed in the early-to-mid phase, producing more coherent gradients and more balanced accuracy across question types without permanently excluding training samples.

</details>


### [213] [Rethinking EEG-Based Disease Diagnosis: Decoupling Instance Representation Learning from Subject-Level Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27274)
*Zhiyuan Ma,Zeyuan Li,Zhiyi Lu,Jiacheng Hao,Youlang Du,Zhen Jiang,Xinche Zhang,Yuhao Sun,Sen Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BridgeMIL 提出一种两阶段多示例学习框架，通过解耦实例表示学习与受试者级监督，在第一阶段使用时间近邻窗口对齐和子袋对比进行无标签预训练，第二阶段结合注意力聚合与特征保持进行微调，在三个EEG疾病数据集上显著优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EEG疾病诊断流程将长时记录分割为短实例并继承受试者标签训练实例级分类器，但不同实例提供的诊断证据可靠性并不均等。多示例学习（MIL）虽能避免标签继承，但EEG数据集中受试者远少于实例，端到端MIL学到的表示质量受限。因此需要一种既能利用丰富实例又能在受试者层面施加监督的新框架。

Method: BridgeMIL采用两阶段框架：第一阶段在无继承标签条件下预训练编码器，通过对齐时间邻近窗口和同一受试者内独立采样的子袋（sub-bags），并引入方差-协方差正则化防止表示坍缩、减少冗余，无需负样本对；第二阶段将编码器迁移至基于注意力的MIL聚合器，仅对受试者级预测施加监督，并通过特征保持（feature retention）机制限制表示漂移。

Result: 在三个EEG疾病数据集和五种代表性骨干网络上，BridgeMIL在15个数据集-骨干组合中的14个上取得最高平均准确率，总体平均准确率达76.57%，比最强基线高4.28个百分点。进一步分析表明：(1)不同实例的继承标签可靠性存在显著差异；(2)模型性能对受试者稀缺的敏感度高于实例稀缺；(3)学到的表示空间具有更清晰的结构，呈现按受试者分明的聚类和更好的诊断类别分离。

Conclusion: 将监督信号与受试者级预测目标对齐至关重要。BridgeMIL通过解耦表示学习与聚合监督，在不给单个EEG实例分配疾病标签的前提下，充分利用大量实例进行学习，为EEG疾病诊断提供了更合理、更高效的MIL范式。

Abstract: EEG-based disease diagnosis requires one prediction per subject, yet common pipelines segment recordings into short instances, inherit the subject label for every instance, and train instance-level classifiers. This assumes that all instances provide equally reliable diagnostic evidence. Multiple instance learning (MIL) avoids inherited labels by treating each subject as a bag. However, EEG datasets contain far fewer subjects than instances, which can limit the quality of the representations learned by end-to-end MIL. We propose BridgeMIL, a two-stage framework that decouples instance representation learning from subject-level supervision. Stage 1 pretrains the encoder without inherited instance labels by aligning temporally nearby windows and independently sampled within-subject sub-bags. Variance and covariance regularization prevent collapse and reduce redundancy without negative pairs. Stage 2 transfers the encoder to an attention-based MIL aggregator, applies supervision only to subject predictions, and limits representation drift through feature retention. Across three EEG disease datasets and five representative backbones, BridgeMIL attains the highest mean accuracy in 14 of 15 dataset-backbone settings and an overall mean accuracy of 76.57%, 4.28 percentage points higher than the strongest baseline. Further analyses reveal substantial variation in inherited-label reliability across instances, greater performance sensitivity to subject scarcity than to instance scarcity, and a more structured representation space with distinct subject-wise clusters and improved separation between diagnostic classes. Together, these findings underscore the importance of aligning supervision with the subject-level prediction objective while learning from abundant EEG instances without assigning disease labels to individual instances.

</details>


### [214] [Flat Score, Amplified Failures: How the Error Budget Masks Damage in Quantized LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27275)
*Jiwon Jang,Kisu Yang,Heuiseok Lim,Hyunwoo Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文检验了"4-bit权重量化几乎无损"的论断在多轮工具调用智能体场景下是否成立。结果表明：标准任务得分确实持平，但量化会放大模型已有的失败模式（如工具名称幻觉），失败量最多增加2.5倍；由于基准测试的错误预算宽松（10次容错），这些新增失败被吸收。缩小容错预算至2次后，得分差距重新暴露（17分）。作者建议在基准测试中同时报告逐通道错误率和紧缩预算下的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 业界普遍认为4-bit权重量化近乎无损，但这一结论主要基于标准NLP基准测试。作者质疑该结论在更复杂的多轮工具调用智能体场景中是否仍然成立，因为这类场景对模型的可靠性要求更高，微小退化可能在实际部署中造成严重后果。

Method: 在τ²-bench基准上，对两个开源模型家族（含dense和MoE变体）在两个领域（电信和零售）进行系统测试。共8个实验单元，每个单元456个episode，在16-bit、8-bit和4-bit三种精度下对比。分析方法包括：（1）标准任务得分对比；（2）等价性检验；（3）过程错误分析（按通道统计错误率和错误类型）；（4）秩相关性分析检验失败集合是否一致；（5）紧缩错误预算（从10降至2）重新计算得分；（6）针对工具名称幻觉的错误修复提示实验。

Result: （1）标准得分无显著差异，等价性检验将最大变化约束在±7.5分内；（2）量化将模型已有失败放大2.5倍（每任务+17.6个错误），但不产生新失败类型（秩相关≥0.94，仅0.18%为新事件）；（3）将错误预算从10缩至2后，在量化引入额外错误量的单元中，得分差距达17分，完全符合"掩蔽效应"的预测；（4）针对性错误修复提示可精确消除量化引入的损伤。

Conclusion: 4-bit量化在多轮智能体场景中并非真正无损——它放大了模型固有的失败模式，但这一退化被宽松的错误预算所掩盖。作者建议基准测试应例行报告逐通道错误率和紧缩预算下的成功率，以更全面地评估量化对智能体可靠性的影响。

Abstract: Post-training quantization to 4-bit weights is widely reported to be nearly lossless. We test this claim for multi-turn, tool-calling agents, where it now matters most. On $τ^2$-bench, across two open-weight model families in dense and MoE variants and two domains (eight cells, 456 episodes each, at 16-, 8-, and 4-bit weights), quantization indeed looks free on the standard metric. No cell shows a score change that survives multiple-comparison correction, and in the cell that carries the largest process damage, equivalence testing bounds the change within $\pm$7.5 points. The process tells a different story. Quantization amplifies the failure the model already exhibits at full precision (tool-name hallucination in telecom, with the same directional trend in retail entity errors) by up to 2.5$\times$ in volume (+17.6 points per task), while creating essentially no new failures. The failure set is the same at every precision (rank correlation $\geq$ 0.94, 0.18% novel events). The score stays flat because the benchmark's ten-error budget absorbs the extra failures. Shrinking the budget to two errors re-exposes a score gap of 17 points, and it does so only in the one cell where quantization added error volume, exactly as the masking account predicts. A targeted error-repair prompt, run for five telecom models at every precision, removes the damage exactly and only where it lives. Both diagnostics, the per-channel error rate and success under a shrinking budget, come from logs benchmarks already collect; we suggest reporting them alongside task reward.

</details>


### [215] [THGFM: Dual-Branch Temporal Heterogeneous Graph Fusion Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27303)
*Yixin Peng,Diego Collarana,Er Jin,Stefan Decker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: THGFM 是一种面向网络规模的时序异构图融合模型，通过双路径架构（共享空间时序注意力 + 关系类型分区时序注意力）并结合旋转时序注意力机制，在参数高效跨类型迁移与关系感知特化之间取得平衡，在多个学术图基准上取得一致的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序异构图是动态关系系统的自然抽象，但现有方法难以兼顾参数高效的跨类型迁移与关系感知特化，且通常仅将时间信息作为注意力核外的加性特征注入，未能将相对时间直接融入注意力分数计算。

Method: 提出THGFM双路径架构：1）共享空间时序注意力分支（Shared-Space Temporal Attention）实现参数高效跨类型迁移；2）关系类型分区时序注意力分支（Relational Type-Partitioned Temporal Attention）实现关系感知特化；3）通过类型条件非竞争门控求和融合（Type-Conditioned Non-Competitive Gated Sum Fusion）整合两分支，允许独立放缩而避免零和竞争；4）引入旋转时序注意力（Rotary Temporal Attention），在匹配前按相对时间的半相位旋转查询和键。

Result: 在学术图基准上一致优于基线图Transformer模型，六任务平均提升+3.25%。具体：OAG-CS PV +12.37%，PF-L₂ +4.87%，PF-L₁ +1.18%，OGBN-MAG +4.24%，HTAG-ArXiv +3.73%，HTAG-DBLP +4.61%。

Conclusion: THGFM通过双路径融合架构和旋转时序注意力，有效解决了时序异构图学习中跨类型迁移与关系特化的矛盾，并将相对时间深度嵌入注意力机制内部，验证了设计在多个基准上的有效性。

Abstract: Temporal heterogeneous graphs offer a natural abstraction for dynamic relational systems in which diverse node and relation types co-exist and evolve over time. Learning on such graphs requires jointly modeling cross-type structural heterogeneity and the temporal dynamics of interactions, yet existing methods still struggle to reconcile parameter-efficient cross-type transfer with relation-aware specialization, and typically inject time only as additive features outside the attention kernel. We propose \textbf{THGFM}, a web-scale temporal heterogeneous graph fusion model that addresses both limitations within a unified dual-path architecture. THGFM couples a \textit{Shared-Space Temporal Attention} branch for parameter-efficient cross-type transfer with a \textit{Relational Type-Partitioned Temporal Attention} branch for relation-aware specialization, and integrates them through \textit{Dual-Path Relational--Shared Fusion}, instantiated with \textit{Type-Conditioned Non-Competitive Gated Sum Fusion}: a adaptive mechanism that assigns independent, type-conditioned feature-wise gates to the shared and specialized branches, allowing both to be amplified or suppressed without zero-sum competition. To directly incorporate relative time into the attention score, THGFM further introduces \textit{Rotary Temporal Attention}, which rotates queries and keys by half-phases of relative time before matching. THGFM consistently outperforms baseline graph transformer models on academic graphs benchmarks, delivering a $+3.25\%$ six-task mean gain, with peak relative gains of $+12.37\%$ on OAG-CS PV, $+4.87\%$ on PF-$L_2$, and $+1.18\%$ on PF-$L_1$, and $+4.24\%$, $+3.73\%$, and $+4.61\%$ on OGBN-MAG, HTAG-ArXiv, and HTAG-DBLP, respectively.

</details>


### [216] [The Kinetics of Training: A Driven-Nucleation Rate Law for Emergence, Plasticity Loss, and Circuit Control in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27281)
*Lei Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 语言模型中新能力的涌现取决于其电路中最后几个组件的联合对齐，这是一个"无部分得分"的稀有事件，缺失部分的数量决定了等待时间。该过程可通过速率方程描述，并可用于预测能力的出现时间和恢复被破坏的可学习性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解语言模型中能力涌现的机制，解释为何能力形成呈现突变式而非渐进式增长，并找出能力形成的限速步骤。

Method: 通过短路自由装置（shortcut-free apparatus）和Pythia模型（7种能力、3种规模）进行电路消融实验；构建基于稀有事件的速率方程；在受控门控注意力模型中验证机制；通过重新初始化query-key切片恢复可学习性。

Result: 1）等待时间取决于缺失部分数量而非电路总规模；2）消融单个电路部件后能力中位数仅剩17%，远低于部分得分预测的50-83%（p=2e-10）；3）速率方程可正向预测能力出现时机（10/10命中），反向预测能力延迟甚至永久丧失；4）重新初始化query-key切片可完全恢复可学习性（6/6），而value切片无效（0/6）；5）标准验证损失无法监测到能力丧失。

Conclusion: 能力涌现是一个"无部分得分"的联合对齐过程，缺失部分数决定了稀有事件的势垒。该机制通过速率方程可量化预测，且损伤可通过针对性重新初始化query-key切片修复，对1.4B参数量级的transformer中的连接电路具有普适性。

Abstract: A capability appears in a language model when the last parts of its circuit align in one stochastic attempt, and getting all but one right is worth nothing. We show this no-partial-credit joint alignment is the rate-limiting step of capability formation. Two fingerprints: in a shortcut-free apparatus a five-part circuit missing three waits as long as a three-part circuit missing three (1.19-1.37), so the wait counts missing parts, not size; and on Pythia across seven capabilities and three scales, ablating one part leaves a median 17% of the capability in 32 of 32 discriminating cells, where partial credit predicts 50-83% (p = 2e-10), while a random non-part head leaves 100%.
  One rare event whose barrier grows with missing parts yields a rate equation -- sites x attempts x drive x exp(-beta*K), minus destruction -- read three ways, each preregistered with frozen constants. Forward: a capability flat at baseline ignites at a step of our choosing once the mix passes a concentration floor (10/10 above, 0/12 below), and while still flat its arrival is datable from its precursor to 5% median error on six held-out models. Backward: the delay to learn a withheld capability grows with waiting until, past a critical step, it never ignites -- yet validation loss falls smoothly throughout, so standard monitors are blind to it. We locate the damage (heads commit to the base data) and isolate the cure: re-initializing only the query-key slices restores learnability (6/6) while the value slices do nothing (0/6). We prove the mechanism in a controlled gated-attention model: occupation forces a deadline whose consequences need no mixing assumption. Completed: SGD's noise fails the fluctuation-dissipation test, so we install one and anneal, melt and pin circuits on schedule. Scope: conjunction circuits in transformers to 1.4B.

</details>


### [217] [Benchmarking the Residual: What Long-Horizon Evaluations Add Beyond Matched Short-Task Performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27283)
*Chao Peng,Zhiheng Lyu,Peijie Dong,Hande Dong,Qiang Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种形式化框架，通过"horizon residual"（水平残差）来区分长任务中的普通错误累积与真正的"轨迹诱导退化"（trajectory-induced degradation）。作者认为现有基准测试不能仅凭任务变长时失败增多就声称存在"长水平失败"，必须将完整任务成功率与基于短阶段独立执行的基线预测进行比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前长水平基准测试虽然观察到智能体在更长任务中失败更多，但这仅是一种相关性观察，无法解释失败的真正原因。任务变长可能只是增加了普通错误的累积机会，也可能是因为后期决策本身更难，或者是因为早期执行产生了"轨迹诱导退化"（如上下文腐化、环境状态积累等），使后续工作变得更困难。需要一种方法来区分这些不同机制。

Method: 作者提出了"水平残差"（horizon residual）的概念，定义为基线预测成功率与实际完整任务成功率之间的对数比值。基线预测基于短阶段独立执行的成功率来推算完整任务应达到的成功率。比较必须使用相同的智能体配置，并预先指定阶段划分、检查点、信息流和预算。残差显著偏离零时，表明完整执行与基线存在差异，但还需要进一步有针对性的实验来解释具体原因。

Result: 本文为立场论文（position paper），主要提出概念框架和分析方法，未报告具体的实证结果。核心贡献是形式化定义了"水平残差"这一度量，并明确了进行此类比较所需的方法论约束。

Conclusion: 要声称存在"长水平失败"，基准测试必须进行基线比较而非仅观察成功率下降。"水平残差"提供了一个统一的度量框架，但残差本身只是表明差异存在，仍需后续实验来区分具体退化机制（如上下文腐化、环境累积效应等）。

Abstract: Long-horizon benchmarks often show that agents fail more as tasks become longer. This observation is useful for deployment, but it does not by itself explain why failure occurs. More stages create more opportunities for ordinary errors to compound; longer tasks may also contain harder individual decisions or become harder as conversation history, tool outputs, and environment changes accumulate. We use trajectory-induced degradation to mean this last possibility: earlier execution makes later work harder. When the harmful accumulation is specifically the text visible to the model, it is often called context rot. In this position paper, we argue that to claim a "long-horizon failure", benchmarks must compare actual full-task success against a baseline prediction built from short, individual stages. We call the log-ratio between this prediction and actual success the horizon residual. The comparison must use the same agent configuration and specify in advance how stages, checkpoints, information, and budgets will be chosen. The residual shows that the full rollout differs from the chosen baseline; targeted experiments are still needed to explain why.

</details>


### [218] [Strategies for Milestone-driven Start-ups in Multi-activity Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27563)
*Zhengli Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究初创企业在里程碑导向下的最优策略选择问题，通过扩散过程建模企业状态，在多个控制（活动）中求解最优策略。作者完全刻画了最优策略的结构，引入"有效前沿曲线"对控制进行排序，并发现不同参数下该曲线类型不同，导致最优策略结构发生质变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 初创企业需要在多个里程碑阶段"生存"下来，但具有三个及以上控制的连续时间随机模型极难求解。现有文献缺乏对里程碑导向下多活动选择策略的完整分析，尤其缺乏对最优策略结构如何随参数发生质变的理解。

Method: 以扩散过程刻画初创企业状态，企业家可在多个控制（活动）间选择，各控制具有不同的成本、漂移率和波动率。企业状态触及上界（成功）或下界（失败）即终止。通过随机最优控制理论，作者完全求解了最优策略，并以"风险性"（漂移-波动率比）和"成本效益"（漂移-成本比）构建有效前沿曲线对控制进行排序。

Result: 最优策略仅使用有效前沿曲线上的控制；该曲线按风险性和成本效益两个直观度量排序。模型的独特之处在于：根据参数不同，有效前沿曲线可呈现不同类型，导致最优策略结构发生质变。这是首次分析允许有效前沿曲线类型变化的随机控制模型。

Conclusion: 研究为初创企业提供了评估活动的直观度量，揭示了里程碑导向下最优策略如何随具体情景发生质变，为创业决策研究奠定了重要基础。

Abstract: New venture start-ups need to ``survive'' through multiple stages of reaching milestone targets. We investigate the strategies for start-ups in a milestone-oriented setting. We examine a model of an entrepreneurial start-up firm, where its state is captured by a diffusion process. The entrepreneur can choose between multiple activities (or controls), which incur different cost and determine the drift and the variance of the process. Depending on whether the process reaches a fixed upper boundary or a lower one, the start-up firm succeeds or fails. Continuous-time stochastic models with multiple ($\ge 3$) controls are typically very challenging to deal with. In this work, we are able to completely solve for the optimal policy and provide an explicit characterization of its structure. In particular, the optimal policy only uses controls from a set characterized by a so-called efficient frontier curve that orders the controls by two intuitive measures: riskiness (drift-to-volatility ratio) and cost-effectiveness (drift-to-cost ratio). A unique feature of our model is that depending on the model parameters, the efficient frontier curves can be of different types, resulting in qualitatively different structures of the optimal policy. As far as we know, this is the first study that analyzes a stochastic control model which admits efficient frontier curves of different types. Our work provides start-up firms with intuitive measures to evaluate their activities and offers valuable insights on how the optimal strategies in a milestone-oriented setting change qualitatively contingent upon the specific scenario. We believe the results provide a foundational block in the study of entrepreneurial decision-making.

</details>


### [219] [TIER-MoE: Trust-Informed Expert Routing via Conditional Modality Risk for Multimodal Fusion in Biomedical Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27289)
*Yu Chang,Anzhe Cheng,Chenwei Wu,Zhuoran Wang,Jiahao Chen,Tamoghna Chattopadhyay,Sophia I. Thomopoulos,Paul M. Thompson,Liyue Shen,Paul Bogdan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TIER-MoE 提出了一种风险引导的子空间混合专家模型，通过样本特定的模态可靠性估计（基于留出预测的损失）结合专家-子空间兼容性进行稀疏路由，在多个生物医学多模态数据集上实现了优于现有方法的预测性能和概率校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态融合方法在分配模态权重时，无法区分该模态是不可靠、冗余还是与专家不匹配；更多证据并不总带来更好预测，需要一种能真正反映模态可靠性的融合机制。

Method: 提出 TIER-MoE 框架：(1) 利用未在对应样本上训练的模型生成的 out-of-fold 预测，学习每个样本特定模态的预期预测损失作为"风险"；(2) 将估计风险与专家特定的子空间兼容性结合，实现稀疏的模态-专家路由；(3) 保留一条始终活跃的共享路径以维持多模态互补性。

Result: 在四个公开生物医学多模态数据集（阿尔茨海默病、皮肤病变恶性程度、视网膜分类）上，TIER-MoE 在 Macro-F1 和 Brier 分数上均一致优于现有最先进方法，并在外部队列上展现出强零样本泛化能力。

Conclusion: TIER-MoE 通过风险引导的稀疏混合专家路由，有效解决了多模态融合中模态可靠性评估不足的问题，不仅提升了预测精度，也显著改善了概率校准质量，具有良好的泛化性能。

Abstract: The promise of multimodal fusion lies in combining complementary sources of evidence, yet more evidence does not always yield a better prediction. Recent multimodal models have advanced fusion through richer cross-modal interaction and sample-adaptive fusion. However, the influence assigned to a modality during fusion does not reveal whether that source is unreliable, redundant, or poorly matched to a specialized expert. To address this limitation, we introduce TIER-MoE, a risk-guided subspace mixture-of-experts model that defines sample-specific modality reliability as the prediction loss its unimodal predictor is expected to incur. This risk is learned from out-of-fold predictions generated by models that were not trained on the corresponding sample. TIER-MoE combines the estimated risk with expert-specific subspace compatibility for sparse modality-expert routing, while an always-active shared path preserves multimodal complementarity. We evaluate TIER-MoE on four public multimodal biomedical datasets spanning Alzheimer's disease status, skin-lesion malignancy, and retinal classification. Results demonstrate its superiority over state-of-the-art methods in predictive performance and probability calibration, with consistent improvements in Macro-F1 and Brier score and strong zero-shot generalization to an external cohort.

</details>


### [220] [EvoCause: LLM-Guided Evolution of Causal Graphs for Root Cause Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27290)
*Lei Zan,Keli Zhang,Shifeng Xie,Jiale Zheng,Zehao Xiao,Zhiwei Dong,Ke Zhang,Ruichu Cai,Malik Tiomoko,Lujia Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EvoCause利用LLM根据专家标注的根因标签对因果图进行语义感知的迭代精炼，在TeleRCA基准（来自生产网络的48.5万条告警）上显著优于固定图方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RCA方法从观测日志学习固定因果图，无法利用历史事件的专家诊断结果来改进图结构。专家标注仅约束哪些节点应为根因，但不指定如何编辑边来满足这些约束，因此需要一种能桥接专家反馈与图结构更新的方法。

Method: EvoCause采用"LLM提议 + 确定性验证"的闭环框架：LLM根据专家标注的根因约束，结合告警名称语义信息，提议图编辑操作（增删边）；确定性代码验证节点标识和图的无环性，并在标注对齐集上保留最优图。推理时仅使用精炼后的图进行透明预测，无需调用LLM。

Result: 在合成数据上，以PC因果发现算法初始化的EvoCause相比未精炼的PC基线，Node F1提升11.59pp，Case EM提升9.40pp，Graph F1提升4.59pp，nSHD降低0.2379。在TeleRCA上，将告警名称替换为匿名标识符后Node F1和Case EM分别下降6.12pp和8.04pp，证实告警名称语义对图精炼有显著贡献。

Conclusion: EvoCause成功将LLM的语义理解能力与因果结构约束相结合，实现专家反馈驱动的因果图迭代精炼，在合成和真实数据上均验证了方法的有效性。同时发布的TeleRCA为告警RCA领域提供了首个大规模专家标注基准。

Abstract: Modern telecommunication, cloud, and microservice systems emit correlated alarm cascades when components fail. Root cause analysis (RCA) aims to identify the small set of alarms that initiate each cascade. A common approach learns a causal graph from observational logs and predicts all zero-in-degree alarms in each incident-induced subgraph. However, the learned graph remains fixed and cannot benefit from expert diagnoses of historical incidents. We close this loop with EvoCause. Expert labels constrain which alarms should be source nodes but do not specify the edge edits needed to satisfy those constraints. EvoCause uses a large language model (LLM) to propose semantically plausible graph edits, while deterministic code validates node identities and acyclicity and retains the best graph on a labeled alignment set. At test time, the refined graph alone produces transparent predictions without an LLM call. We also release TeleRCA, an expert-annotated benchmark from a production telecommunication network containing $485{,}681$ alarm events spanning $194$ alarm types over $5{,}621$ resources. On synthetic data, EvoCause initialized with the PC causal discovery algorithm outperforms the unrefined PC baseline, raising Node F1, Case EM, and Graph F1 by $11.59$, $9.40$, and $4.59$ percentage points, respectively, while reducing nSHD by $0.2379$. On TeleRCA, replacing human-readable alarm titles with anonymous identifiers lowers Node F1 and Case EM by $6.12$ and $8.04$ percentage points, respectively, indicating that alarm-name information contributes to graph refinement.

</details>


### [221] [Encryption-Compatible Clustered Federated Learning via Distributed Expectation-Maximization over Metadata](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28338)
*Michael Ben Ali,Imen Megdiche,André Péninou,Olivier Teste*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对聚类联邦学习（CFL）中隐私、通信效率与计算效率三者不可兼得的"三难困境"，提出 FLAMECHE 方法，将基于元数据的 CFL 重构为分布式期望最大化（EM）过程，使服务器更新仅涉及加法操作，从而兼容安全联邦学习方案，在保持效率的同时增强隐私保护。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 CFL 方法在隐私保护、通信成本和计算效率之间存在权衡（CFL trilemma）。基于元数据的聚类方法虽然通信和计算效率高，但不兼容标准的联邦学习隐私保护机制（如安全聚合）。作者旨在打破这一困境，设计一种既能保持元数据聚类效率、又能兼容隐私保护方案的 CFL 方法。

Method: 提出 FLAMECHE，核心思路是将基于元数据的 CFL 重新形式化为分布式 EM（期望最大化）过程。具体来说，将服务器端的更新操作限制为仅涉及加法运算，从而使得该方法能够直接兼容基于安全多方计算或同态加密的实用安全联邦学习方案，在不牺牲通信和计算效率的前提下实现隐私保护。

Result: 在多个数据集和多种异构场景下的广泛实验表明，FLAMECHE 提升了客户端模型的有效性，并成功实现了加密兼容的基于元数据的聚类，在 CFL 三难困境中取得了更优的定位。

Conclusion: FLAMECHE 通过将元数据 CFL 重构为分布式 EM 过程，成功打破了 CFL 三难困境，首次实现了加密兼容的高效元数据聚类联邦学习，为隐私保护下的聚类联邦学习提供了新的可行范式。

Abstract: Clustered Federated Learning (CFL) addresses data heterogeneity in federated settings by grouping clients with similar data distributions to enable effective training. Existing methods face a trade-off between privacy preservation, communication cost, and computational efficiency. We formalize this as the CFL trilemma, according to which improving two of these dimensions comes at the expense of the third. A prominent paradigm relies on metadata (i.e., low-dimensional representations of client datasets shared with the server) to enable communication- and computation-efficient clustering. However, such approaches are not compatible with standard FL privacy-preserving mechanisms. To address this limitation, we propose FLAMECHE, which reformulates metadata-based CFL as a distributed Expectation-Maximization (EM) procedure, restricting server updates to additive operations while preserving efficiency. This design enables compatibility with practical secure FL schemes. We conducted extensive experiments on multiple datasets under various heterogeneous scenarios. Results show that FLAMECHE improves the effectiveness of client models. It enables encryption-compatible metadata-based clustering, enhancing its positioning within the CFL trilemma.

</details>


### [222] [Position, Not Provenance: Separating Reasoning Mediation from Sycophancy in Medical Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27304)
*Supratik Bhowal,Subhrajyoti Basu,Aritra Gir Mahanta,Anik Pal Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CoT-Mediate框架，通过扰动医学VLM自身生成推理中的单个临床属性，测量预测是否跟随编辑后的推理，从而评估推理对预测的因果影响。研究发现推理注入机制显著影响测量到的忠实度，上下文位置而非声明的来源是决定模型是否使用其生成推理的主要因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前医学视觉语言模型（VLMs）在回答临床问题前会生成思维链（CoT）推理，但这种推理是否对预测产生因果性影响尚不明确。现有评估方法难以区分模型是真正依赖推理进行预测，还是仅仅表现出迎合行为（sycophancy）。

Method: 提出CoT-Mediate行为框架，包含两个核心设计：（1）双臂协议——比较"重新提示证据"（re-prompted evidence）与"前缀强制续写"（prefix-forced continuation）两种推理注入方式；（2）来源控制干预——在保持推理内容相同的情况下仅改变推理的归因来源，以解耦推理中介效应与迎合效应。在LLaVA-Med和MedGemma两个模型上，各使用1,000个VQA-RAD样本进行评估。

Result: （1）前缀强制续写一致地比重新提示产生更高的中介忠实度；（2）来源分析揭示了模型间截然不同的顺从行为模式；（3）两个模型中，移除视觉证据会增加对注入推理的依赖；（4）laterality（左右侧性）是被最不忠实地追踪的临床属性。

Conclusion: 推理注入机制对测量到的忠实度有显著影响；上下文位置（而非声明的来源）是决定医学VLM是否使用其生成推理的主要因素。该框架为评估医学VLM推理的因果忠实度提供了更可靠的方法。

Abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) generate chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning before answering clinical questions, but whether this reasoning causally influences predictions remains unclear. We present CoT-Mediate, a behavioral framework that perturbs a single clinically meaningful attribute within a model's own generated reasoning and measures whether the resulting prediction follows the edited reasoning. Our framework combines a dual-arm protocol comparing re-prompted evidence with prefix-forced continuation, together with a provenance-controlled intervention that varies only the attributed source of identical reasoning to disentangle reasoning mediation from sycophancy. We evaluate LLaVA-Med and MedGemma on 1,000 VQA-RAD samples each. Prefix-forced continuation consistently yields higher mediation faithfulness than re-prompting, while the provenance analysis reveals distinct model-specific deference behaviors. Across both models, removing visual evidence increases reliance on injected reasoning, whereas laterality is the least faithfully tracked clinical attribute. These results show that the mechanism used to inject reasoning substantially affects measured faithfulness and that contextual position, rather than stated provenance, is the primary determinant of whether medical VLMs use their generated reasoning.

</details>


### [223] [On-Policy and Off-Policy Learning for Large Action Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28408)
*Imad Aouali*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究大规模动作空间下交互式系统的策略学习，涵盖在线（on-policy）和离线（off-policy）两种情境化赌博机范式。针对在线学习，提出混合效应汤普森采样（meTS）和扩散先验汤普森采样（dTS）两种结构化贝叶斯方法；针对离线学习，提出结构化直接方法（sDM）、可高效优化的凹目标函数，以及基于指数平滑和PAC-贝叶斯界的可微分悲观方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大动作空间的上下文赌博机中，在线学习面临探索效率低下的问题，离线学习则面临数据覆盖稀疏、重要性权重方差高、外推偏差和优化困难等挑战。现有方法难以在这些场景下有效共享动作间的信息并控制偏差-方差权衡。

Method: 在线学习方面：(1) meTS——混合效应汤普森采样扩展，共享动作间信息；(2) dTS——利用扩散启发先验建模动作间依赖关系。两种方法均以有效动作数给出遗憾界。离线学习方面：(1) sDM——基于隐变量的结构化直接方法；(2) 揭示大动作空间中优化误差可主导估计误差，提出凹的、可高效优化的策略加权对数似然目标；(3) 基于指数平滑和PAC-贝叶斯界的可微分悲观方法，控制正则化重要性采样估计器的偏差-方差权衡。

Result: 在线方法获得了依赖于有效动作数（而非真实动作总数）的遗憾界；离线方法中，凹目标函数实现高效优化，悲观方法有效控制了偏差-方差权衡。

Conclusion: 通过结构化先验共享信息和精心设计的优化目标，可以显著缓解大动作空间给在线和离线策略学习带来的根本性困难。结构化贝叶斯方法降低了在线探索的复杂度，悲观方法与高效优化目标则为离线策略评估与学习提供了可行路径。

Abstract: This thesis studies policy learning in interactive systems where an agent observes a context, selects an action from a very large set, and receives partial feedback. The main framework is contextual bandits, with two paradigms: on-policy learning, where the agent interacts sequentially with the environment and minimizes regret, and off-policy learning, where it learns from logged data collected by a logging policy. In large action spaces, both settings face major challenges: inefficient exploration, sparse data coverage, high-variance importance weights, extrapolation bias, and difficult optimization landscapes. The first part develops structured Bayesian methods for on-policy learning. We introduce meTS, a mixed-effect extension of Thompson sampling, and dTS, which leverages diffusion-inspired priors to model dependencies between actions. These methods share information across actions and yield regret guarantees depending on an effective number of actions. The second part addresses off-policy learning. We propose sDM, a structured direct method based on latent variables, show that optimization error can dominate estimation error in large action spaces, and introduce concave, efficiently optimizable policy-weighted log-likelihood objectives. Finally, we develop differentiable pessimistic methods based on exponential smoothing and PAC-Bayesian bounds to control the bias-variance trade-off of regularized importance-sampling estimators.

</details>


### [224] [ZUNA1.1: A more flexible EEG foundation model for Denoising and Super-resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27308)
*Christopher Warner,Jonas Mago,JR Huml,Beren Millidge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ZUNA1.1 是一个380M参数的扩散自编码器，用于灵活的EEG信号重建，支持可变长度序列、任意通道数、任意头皮位置及任意时间间隔的重建，性能优于前代ZUNA1和传统方法如球面样条插值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EEG重建方法（如球面样条插值）灵活性不足，无法处理可变长度序列、任意通道配置和任意时间间隔的重建任务；前代ZUNA1模型虽性能优异但灵活性有限，需要一种既能保持高性能又能应对多样化重建需求的统一模型。

Method: 提出ZUNA1.1，一个380M参数的扩散自编码器（diffusion autoencoder）。该模型能够处理最长30秒的可变长度EEG序列，支持任意数量的通道和任意头皮位置，并可重建通道内的任意时间间隔以及完整通道。

Result: ZUNA1.1 性能至少与前代ZUNA1持平，同时灵活性大幅提升；在多种重建任务中显著优于标准EEG去噪和重建方法（如MNE中广泛使用的球面样条插值）。

Conclusion: ZUNA1.1 成功在保持高性能的同时实现了对多样化EEG重建任务的高度灵活性，并以Apache 2.0许可开源，为EEG信号处理提供了一个强大且通用的开源工具。

Abstract: We introduce ZUNA1.1, a 380M-parameter diffusion autoencoder for flexible EEG signal reconstruction. ZUNA1.1 is capable of reconstructing variable length sequences of up to 30s, with an arbitrary number of EEG channels at arbitrary scalp locations, and can reconstruct arbitrary temporal intervals within channels in addition to reconstructing entire channels. We demonstrate that ZUNA1.1 performs at least on par with our earlier ZUNA1 model, while being far more flexible and capable of handling a wide range of reconstruction tasks. ZUNA1.1 continues to substantially outperform standard EEG denoising and reconstruction methods such as spherical spline interpolation, which is ubiquitously deployed in the MNE package. The ZUNA1.1 model is released open source under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.

</details>


### [225] [Modeling Decisions in Blockchain Analytics: A Leakage-Aware Evaluation of Tree-Based vs. Sequential Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27350)
*Michał Bartnicki,Jarosław A. Chudziak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对以太坊Sybil机器人检测中存在的标签泄漏问题，提出了Blind-Spot协议和Transaction Grammar表示方法，发现在泄漏感知评估下，XGBoost表格模型优于Transformer等序列模型，且具有更低延迟和能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于深度学习的Sybil检测方法将区块链活动视为序列数据进行建模，但存在两个关键问题：(1) 复杂序列模型计算开销大，难以实现实时监控；(2) 高信号智能合约导致的标签泄漏会虚增模型性能。因此需要探究有机用户、Sybil机器人和MEV机器人在交易历史结构复杂性上的本质差异，并在消除泄漏后评估序列模型与表格模型的真实性能对比。

Method: 提出泄漏感知的Sybil检测框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) Blind-Spot协议——通过消除与高信号合约关联的捷径来防止标签泄漏；(2) Transaction Grammar表示——从节奏(rhythm)、EVM执行结构和意图(intent)三个维度对钱包行为建模。在以太坊参与者分类任务上，对比Transformer和BiLSTM序列模型与XGBoost、SVM基线模型的性能。

Result: 在泄漏感知评估条件下，XGBoost在分类性能上优于基于Transformer的序列模型，同时具有更低的推理延迟和更少的预估能耗。

Conclusion: 消除标签泄漏后，传统表格模型（XGBoost）在以太坊参与者分类任务上优于复杂序列模型，且更适用于低延迟的实时部署场景。Transaction Grammar作为一种钱包行为建模方法具有实用价值。

Abstract: Sybil bots are Ethereum actors that imitate legitimate users to extract airdrop rewards or influence governance. Recent Sybil detection methods increasingly use deep learning and treat blockchain activity as a quasi-linguistic sequence. However, complex sequence models are computationally expensive for real-time monitoring, and their reported performance may be inflated by label leakage from high-signal smart contracts. We ask whether and how organic users, Sybil bots, and MEV bots differ in the structural complexity of their transaction histories; whether sequential models outperform tree-based tabular models once leakage is reduced; whether transaction order or timing provides the stronger behavioral signal; and whether the resulting models are practical for low-latency deployment. Our approach to leakage-aware Sybil bot detection consists of a Blind-Spot protocol and a Transaction Grammar representation of wallet behavior. The former eliminates shortcuts associated with high-signal contracts, whereas the latter models wallets using rhythm, EVM execution structure, and intent. We evaluate this approach on Ethereum actor classification by comparing Transformer and BiLSTM sequence models against XGBoost and SVM baselines. We contribute a framework for leakage-aware Ethereum actor classification and a Transaction Grammar representation of wallet behavior. Our results demonstrate that, under leakage-aware evaluation, XGBoost outperforms Transformer-based sequence models while providing lower latency and estimated energy use.

</details>


### [226] [Compression-Based Behavioral Similarity for Open-World Sybil Discovery on Ethereum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27370)
*Michał Bartnicki,Jarosław A. Chudziak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需监督训练、基于压缩相似度（NCD）的Sybil行为发现框架，通过从EVM轨迹中合成交易语法并利用Blind-Spot协议过滤高信号合约，构建行为图以区分Sybil机器人、有机用户和套利机器人，且在时序漂移和对抗扰动下表现出鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Sybil检测方法依赖代币转移图或封闭集分类的机器学习，前者要求钱包间存在直接金融链接，后者难以应对攻击策略的频繁变化和规避手段。作者旨在探索：基于压缩的相似度能否在不依赖直接金融链接的情况下区分Sybil、有机用户和套利机器人；高信号合约对Sybil发现的影响；行为图在时序漂移和对抗扰动下的鲁棒性。

Method: 从EVM轨迹中合成符号化的交易语法（Transaction Grammar），分别捕获交易节奏、执行结构和功能意图；通过自研的Blind-Spot Protocol过滤高信号合约；使用基于Gzip的归一化压缩距离（NCD）构建行为图进行Sybil发现。验证方式包括与有监督机器学习基线对比、时序分割测试以及合成伪装压力测试。

Result: 该框架在与有监督机器学习基线的对比中展现出竞争力；在时序分割测试中保持有效；在合成伪装压力测试中表现出对对抗扰动的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 贡献了一个面向开放世界区块链审计的、泄漏感知的行为发现框架，其核心NCD原语无需监督训练，可在无显式资金链接的情况下扩展可疑种子钱包。该方法定位为一种无训练的本地发现原语，而非正式的开集识别系统。

Abstract: Sybil attackers are Blockchain actors that adopt the characteristics of regular users to exploit airdrops or influence governance. Current methods of Sybil actor detection include constructing graphs, which requires token transfers between examined wallets. Machine learning algorithms have been employed as well, but they treat the task as a closed-set classification problem, making them vulnerable to frequent changes in attack strategies or evasion tactics. We address the following questions: can compression-based similarity differentiate Sybil bots, organic users, and arbitrage bot wallets without direct financial links? What is the effect of high-signal contracts on the discovery of Sybils, and how robust are behavioral graphs under temporal drift and adversarial perturbations? Our approach synthesizes a symbolic Transaction Grammar from EVM (Ethereum Virtual Machine) traces, capturing separately transaction rhythm, execution structure, and functional intent. The high-signal contracts are filtered with our own protocol, called the Blind-Spot Protocol. Gzip-based NCD is used to construct a behavioral graph for Sybil discovery. We validate this framework against supervised machine learning baselines, a temporal split, and synthetic camouflage stress tests. Ultimately, we contribute a leakage-aware behavioral framework for Sybil candidate discovery. Its core NCD primitive requires no supervised training and can expand suspicious seed wallets without explicit funding links. We position the method as a training-free local discovery primitive for open-world blockchain audits, rather than as a formal open-set recognition system.

</details>


### [227] [Explorative Modeling: Unlocking a Third Pretraining Axis and End-to-End Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27372)
*Alexi Gladstone,Heng Ji,Yilun Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出探索式建模（Explorative Modeling, XM），一种新的生成建模范式：在训练循环中对模型生成与数据之间进行K个候选匹配的探索，选择最佳匹配进行训练，使预测倾向于模式而非模糊化。XM既可作为现有生成模型的第三预训练轴（超越参数和数据缩放），也可作为独立的端到端生成建模范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
